taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror (Sky130 1.8 V)
* Two self-biased wide-swing cascode NMOS mirror cores, one per reference.
* Iout = ACC*ICC + APTAT*IPTAT with
*   ACC   = 4 (fixed) + 4*(!b0) + 8*(!b1)
*   APTAT = 4 (fixed) + 4*( b0) + 8*( b1)
* so ACC:APTAT = 16:4 / 12:8 / 8:12 / 4:16 for codes 00/01/10/11 and
* ACC+APTAT = 20 -> ~1 mA at 27 C for every code.
* Unit cell: bottom w=192 l=1 (Vdsat~65mV @50uA), cascode w=288 l=0.8.
* R=3.9k self-bias puts the cascode gate (the ref pin) one I*R above the
* bottom gate, so bottom Vds ~ 150-260 mV, matched input-to-output.
* Segment enable is gate steering: a pass NMOS ties the segment bottom gate
* to the mirror bias node, a pulldown NMOS grounds it when disabled. The
* switches carry no DC current, so they cost no headroom and no ratio error.
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---- control inverters (gate load only, ~zero static current) ----
XINV0P nb0 ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.35
XINV0N nb0 ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.35
XINV1P nb1 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.35
XINV1N nb1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.35

* ================= ICC mirror core =================
* Self-biased wide-swing cascode input: all of ICC flows through RCC, so the
* cascode gate (the pin) rides ICC*RCC above the bottom-mirror gate bg_cc.
RCC icc_ref bg_cc 3.9k
XMCCCI bg_cc icc_ref sx_cc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=288 l=0.8 nf=8
XMCCBI sx_cc bg_cc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=192 l=1 nf=8
CCC bg_cc vss 2p
CCA icc_ref vss 1p
* fixed 4x segment
XMCCB4F ncc4f bg_cc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=192 l=1 nf=8 m=4
XMCCC4F iout icc_ref ncc4f vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=288 l=0.8 nf=8 m=4
* switched 4x segment, enabled when b0=0
XMCCB4S ncc4s g_cc4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=192 l=1 nf=8 m=4
XMCCC4S iout icc_ref ncc4s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=288 l=0.8 nf=8 m=4
XSCC4A bg_cc nb0 g_cc4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.35
XSCC4B g_cc4 ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.35
* switched 8x segment, enabled when b1=0
XMCCB8S ncc8s g_cc8 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=192 l=1 nf=8 m=8
XMCCC8S iout icc_ref ncc8s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=288 l=0.8 nf=8 m=8
XSCC8A bg_cc nb1 g_cc8 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.35
XSCC8B g_cc8 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.35

* ================= IPTAT mirror core =================
RPT iptat_ref bg_pt 3.9k
XMPTCI bg_pt iptat_ref sx_pt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=288 l=0.8 nf=8
XMPTBI sx_pt bg_pt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=192 l=1 nf=8
CPT bg_pt vss 2p
CPA iptat_ref vss 1p
* fixed 4x segment
XMPTB4F npt4f bg_pt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=192 l=1 nf=8 m=4
XMPTC4F iout iptat_ref npt4f vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=288 l=0.8 nf=8 m=4
* switched 4x segment, enabled when b0=1
XMPTB4S npt4s g_pt4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=192 l=1 nf=8 m=4
XMPTC4S iout iptat_ref npt4s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=288 l=0.8 nf=8 m=4
XSPT4A bg_pt ratio_b0 g_pt4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.35
XSPT4B g_pt4 nb0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.35
* switched 8x segment, enabled when b1=1
XMPTB8S npt8s g_pt8 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=192 l=1 nf=8 m=8
XMPTC8S iout iptat_ref npt8s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=288 l=0.8 nf=8 m=8
XSPT8A bg_pt ratio_b1 g_pt8 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.35
XSPT8B g_pt8 nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.35

.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror, Sky130 1.8 V CMOS.
* Iout = ACC*ICC + APTAT*IPTAT with (ACC,APTAT) = (16,4)/(12,8)/(8,12)/(4,16)
* for ratio_b1:ratio_b0 = 00/01/10/11. Unit mirror cell carries 1x reference.
*
* Each reference pin drives a self-biased wide-swing cascode diode:
*   pin -> R -> bottom-gate node -> cascode (gate = pin) -> bottom -> vss.
* The I*R drop sets the bottom VDS; output segments replicate the same
* bottom+cascode unit so input and output bottom devices see equal VDS.
* Segment gates are steered by transmission gates (enable) and NMOS
* pull-downs (disable). Disabled segments have both gates grounded.
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* -------- digital complements (static CMOS inverters) --------
XINV0P b0n ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XINV0N b0n ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XINV1P b1n ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XINV1N b1n ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

* -------- ICC input branch (1x unit) --------
RICC icc_ref gbi 4.3k
XMCI gbi icc_ref si vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XMBI si gbi vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=40 nf=8
CICC gbi vss 1p

* -------- IPTAT input branch (1x unit) --------
RPT iptat_ref gbp 4.3k
XMCP gbp iptat_ref sp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XMBP sp gbp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=40 nf=8
CPT gbp vss 1p

* ================= ICC output side =================
* base 4x, always on
XMBIA sia gbi vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=160 nf=32
XMCIA iout icc_ref sia vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=160 nf=32

* 4x segment, enabled when ratio_b0 = 0
XSNBIB gbi b0n gbib vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSPBIB gbi ratio_b0 gbib vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPDBIB gbib ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSNCIB icc_ref b0n gcib vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSPCIB icc_ref ratio_b0 gcib vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPDCIB gcib ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMBIB sib gbib vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=160 nf=32
XMCIB iout gcib sib vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=160 nf=32

* 8x segment, enabled when ratio_b1 = 0
XSNBIC gbi b1n gbic vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSPBIC gbi ratio_b1 gbic vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPDBIC gbic ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSNCIC icc_ref b1n gcic vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSPCIC icc_ref ratio_b1 gcic vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPDCIC gcic ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMBIC sic gbic vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=320 nf=64
XMCIC iout gcic sic vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=320 nf=64

* ================= IPTAT output side =================
* base 4x, always on
XMBPA spa gbp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=160 nf=32
XMCPA iout iptat_ref spa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=160 nf=32

* 4x segment, enabled when ratio_b0 = 1
XSNBPB gbp ratio_b0 gbpb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSPBPB gbp b0n gbpb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPDBPB gbpb b0n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSNCPB iptat_ref ratio_b0 gcpb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSPCPB iptat_ref b0n gcpb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPDCPB gcpb b0n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMBPB spb gbpb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=160 nf=32
XMCPB iout gcpb spb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=160 nf=32

* 8x segment, enabled when ratio_b1 = 1
XSNBPC gbp ratio_b1 gbpc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSPBPC gbp b1n gbpc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPDBPC gbpc b1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSNCPC iptat_ref ratio_b1 gcpc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSPCPC iptat_ref b1n gcpc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPDCPC gcpc b1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMBPC spc gbpc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=320 nf=64
XMCPC iout gcpc spc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=320 nf=64

.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror (Sky130 1.8 V devices).
*
* Architecture
*   - One wide-swing cascode mirror input per reference. A series resistor
*     from the reference pin sets the cascode gate line at the pin itself,
*     I*Rc above the main gate line, so the input branch is a full VDS
*     replica of every output segment (accurate gain, wide compliance).
*   - 20 identical output segments of 50 uA nominal each:
*       4 fixed on ICC, 4 fixed on IPTAT,
*       4 steered by ratio_b0, 8 steered by ratio_b1
*       (bit = 0 -> segment mirrors ICC, bit = 1 -> segment mirrors IPTAT)
*     giving ACC = 16-4*code and APTAT = 4+4*code with ACC+APTAT = 20.
*   - Steering swaps each group's main-gate and cascode-gate lines through
*     transmission gates. Gate lines carry no DC current, so the ratio code
*     cannot disturb the reference pins and the two pins stay isolated.
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---------------- code inverters (only vdd loads; static ~ leakage) -------
XIP0 b0n ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2 nf=1
XIN0 b0n ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1 nf=1
XIP1 b1n ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2 nf=1
XIN1 b1n ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------- ICC mirror input (one unit, wide-swing) -----------------
RCI icc_ref gm_icc 4.3k
XMICI gm_icc icc_ref x_icc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=12
XMIMI x_icc gm_icc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=48 nf=12

* ---------------- IPTAT mirror input (one unit, wide-swing) ---------------
RCP iptat_ref gm_pt 3.6k
XMICP gm_pt iptat_ref x_pt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=12
XMIMP x_pt gm_pt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=48 nf=12

* ---------------- fixed output banks (4 units each) -----------------------
XMOCFI iout icc_ref xf_icc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=192 nf=48
XMOMFI xf_icc gm_icc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=192 nf=48
XMOCFP iout iptat_ref xf_pt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=192 nf=48
XMOMFP xf_pt gm_pt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=192 nf=48

* ---------------- group A: 4 units steered by ratio_b0 --------------------
XMOCA iout gc_a xa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=192 nf=48
XMOMA xa gm_a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=192 nf=48
* main-gate line steering
XTAN1 gm_icc b0n gm_a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1 nf=1
XTAP1 gm_icc ratio_b0 gm_a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2 nf=1
XTAN2 gm_pt ratio_b0 gm_a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1 nf=1
XTAP2 gm_pt b0n gm_a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2 nf=1
* cascode-gate line steering
XTAN3 icc_ref b0n gc_a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1 nf=1
XTAP3 icc_ref ratio_b0 gc_a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2 nf=1
XTAN4 iptat_ref ratio_b0 gc_a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1 nf=1
XTAP4 iptat_ref b0n gc_a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------- group B: 8 units steered by ratio_b1 --------------------
XMOCB iout gc_b xb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=384 nf=96
XMOMB xb gm_b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=384 nf=96
* main-gate line steering
XTBN1 gm_icc b1n gm_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1 nf=1
XTBP1 gm_icc ratio_b1 gm_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2 nf=1
XTBN2 gm_pt ratio_b1 gm_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1 nf=1
XTBP2 gm_pt b1n gm_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2 nf=1
* cascode-gate line steering
XTBN3 icc_ref b1n gc_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1 nf=1
XTBP3 icc_ref ratio_b1 gc_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2 nf=1
XTBN4 iptat_ref ratio_b1 gc_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1 nf=1
XTBP4 iptat_ref b1n gc_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2 nf=1

.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* programmable_current_mirror -- Sky130 1.8 V programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS sink
*
* Reference inputs
*   One low-voltage cascode mirror input per reference pin.  The pin is the
*   drain of a weight-1 cascode whose source drives a weight-1 bottom device,
*   and the pin itself is that bottom device's gate.  The pin therefore rests
*   at a single Vgs (~0.55..0.71 V over PVT) instead of the stacked 2*Vgs of a
*   textbook cascode mirror, which keeps it inside the 0.20..1.10 V reference
*   compliance window with margin at both ends.
*
* Output
*   A single shared cascode carries the whole summed output current, so every
*   bottom device -- both weight-1 input replicas included -- sits at the same
*   drain voltage.  The mirror weights are then set by width ratio alone, with
*   no channel-length-modulation term between input and output branches.
*
* Ratio control (unit = one reference current, 20 units = 1 mA at 27 C)
*   4 units hard-wired to icc_ref, 4 units hard-wired to iptat_ref, a 4-unit
*   segment whose gate is steered to icc_ref (b0=0) or iptat_ref (b0=1), and
*   an 8-unit segment steered the same way by b1:
*     ACC   = 4 + 4*~b0 + 8*~b1  = 16, 12, 8, 4
*     APTAT = 4 + 4* b0 + 8* b1  =  4,  8, 12, 16
*   Steering a gate between the two bias nodes -- rather than switching a
*   segment on and off -- keeps ACC+APTAT = 20 for every code.  The summed
*   current, the shared cascode operating point and both reference-pin
*   voltages are therefore code independent, and because the steering
*   switches only ever drive MOS gates, neither reference nor either digital
*   pin sources any static current through them.  RG4/RG8 are high-value
*   keep-alive ties that give each steered gate node a defined DC path when
*   both of its switches are off; they are returned to the internal vb2 bias
*   rather than to a reference pin so that no resistive bridge is ever formed
*   between icc_ref and iptat_ref.  At 100 Mohm they carry under 4 nA.
*
* Cascode gate bias
*   vb2 is a diode-connected NMOS fed from vdd through a resistor.  The common
*   bottom-drain voltage is vb2 minus the cascode Vgs; both terms are Vth
*   referenced, so that node tracks process and temperature.  Biasing vb2 from
*   vdd instead of from a reference replica leaves the two reference pins fully
*   independent: perturbing one reference moves neither the other pin nor the
*   other reference's measured weight.
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---------------- cascode gate bias ----------------
RB    vdd vb2 50k
XMB   vb2 vb2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------- reference input branches (weight 1 each) ----------------
XNCI  xc  icc_ref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=96 nf=32
XCCI  icc_ref  vb2  xc  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=36 nf=12
XNPI  xp  iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=96 nf=32
XCPI  iptat_ref vb2 xp  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=36 nf=12

* ------- output bottom segments: five weight-4 units, 20 units total ------
XNC4F xo icc_ref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=384 nf=128
XNP4F xo iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=384 nf=128
XNS4  xo g4        vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=384 nf=128
XNS8A xo g8        vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=384 nf=128
XNS8B xo g8        vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=384 nf=128

* ---- shared output cascode: four weight-5 units, weight 20 in total -----
XCOA  iout vb2 xo vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=180 nf=60
XCOB  iout vb2 xo vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=180 nf=60
XCOC  iout vb2 xo vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=180 nf=60
XCOD  iout vb2 xo vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=180 nf=60

* ---------------- ratio-code gate steering ----------------
RG4   g4 vb2 100e6
RG8   g8 vb2 100e6
XSW4C icc_ref   b0b      g4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XSW4P iptat_ref ratio_b0 g4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XSW8C icc_ref   b1b      g8 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XSW8P iptat_ref ratio_b1 g8 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1

* ---------------- code inverters (static CMOS, no static current) --------
XI0P  b0b ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XI0N  b0b ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XI1P  b1b ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XI1N  b1b ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* programmable_current_mirror
*   Segmented wide-swing (high-swing) cascode NMOS current-sink mirror.
*
*   Two independent reference legs turn the forced ICC / IPTAT currents into
*   two mirror gate voltages.  Each leg is a wide-swing cascode diode: the
*   reference pin is the cascode drain and also the gate of the bottom
*   (mirror) device, so the reference pin sits at one Vgs (0.58..0.71 V over
*   the signoff corners) while the bottom device's drain sits at the low
*   node Vx = Ib*RB (~0.21 V).  Every output segment's bottom device sees
*   that same Vx, so the mirror ratio is set by width ratios only (identical
*   L, identical per-finger width, so nf scales exact integer replicas).
*
*   Output = sum of 6 cascoded segments (unit = 1x the reference leg):
*     ICC   path: 4 units always on, 4 units on when b0=0, 8 units when b1=0
*     IPTAT path: 4 units always on, 4 units on when b0=1, 8 units when b1=1
*   -> ACC   = 16-8*b1-4*b0  = 16,12,8,4   and
*      APTAT =  4+8*b1+4*b0  =  4, 8,12,16 for codes 00,01,10,11.
*
*   A segment is disabled by grounding only its cascode gate: the bottom
*   device stays biased by the reference pin (no reference-pin loading change
*   with code) and is pushed into deep triode with Vds ~ 0, so the segment
*   carries only leakage and no node is left floating.
*
*   Cascode bias: ncas = Vgs(MD) + Ib*RB, with Ib = ICC/5 = 10 uA and MD
*   scaled to the same current density and the same source potential as the
*   cascode devices, so Vgs(MD) tracks Vgs(casc) and the bottom-device drain
*   Vx = ncas - Vgs(casc) stays at Ib*RB (0.20..0.22 V measured, ss..ff).
*   Ib is generated by a plain ICC replica into a PMOS diode/mirror pair, so
*   the bias chain is fed only from the forced references: there is no
*   positive-feedback loop and no zero-current operating point.
*
*   All device widths are > 7 um total so that only the wide, well-behaved
*   SKY130 model bins are used (narrower bins hold unphysical vsat values).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---- Ib = ICC/5 replica, level shifted to a PMOS source (no start-up loop)
XMB   nbp   icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=6
XMPD  nbp   nbp     vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=6
XMPB  ncas  nbp     vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=6
* ---- cascode gate bias: ncas = Vgs(MD) + Ib*RB
XMD   ncas  ncas    nrb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=6
RB    nrb   vss     20k

* ---- ICC reference leg (1 unit)
XRIB  nxri     icc_ref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=30
XRIC  icc_ref  ncas    nxri vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=30

* ---- IPTAT reference leg (1 unit)
XRPB  nxrp       iptat_ref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=30
XRPC  iptat_ref  ncas      nxrp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=30

* ---- code complements
XI0N  b0b ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XI0P  b0b ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XI1N  b1b ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XI1P  b1b ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4

* ---- switched cascode-gate rails (pass gate to ncas, pull-down to vss)
* ncb0 = ncas when b0=1
XGB0N ncas ratio_b0 ncb0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XGB0P ncas b0b      ncb0 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XGB0D ncb0 b0b      vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
* ncn0 = ncas when b0=0
XGN0N ncas b0b      ncn0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XGN0P ncas ratio_b0 ncn0 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XGN0D ncn0 ratio_b0 vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
* ncb1 = ncas when b1=1
XGB1N ncas ratio_b1 ncb1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XGB1P ncas b1b      ncb1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XGB1D ncb1 b1b      vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
* ncn1 = ncas when b1=0
XGN1N ncas b1b      ncn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XGN1P ncas ratio_b1 ncn1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XGN1D ncn1 ratio_b1 vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2

* ---- ICC output segments: 4 units always, 4 units (b0=0), 8 units (b1=0)
XCA_B nxca icc_ref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=240 nf=120
XCA_C iout ncas    nxca vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=240 nf=120
XCB_B nxcb icc_ref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=240 nf=120
XCB_C iout ncn0    nxcb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=240 nf=120
XCC_B nxcc icc_ref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=480 nf=240
XCC_C iout ncn1    nxcc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=480 nf=240

* ---- IPTAT output segments: 4 units always, 4 units (b0=1), 8 units (b1=1)
XPA_B nxpa iptat_ref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=240 nf=120
XPA_C iout ncas      nxpa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=240 nf=120
XPB_B nxpb iptat_ref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=240 nf=120
XPB_C iout ncb0      nxpb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=240 nf=120
XPC_B nxpc iptat_ref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=480 nf=240
XPC_C iout ncb1      nxpc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=480 nf=240

.ends programmable_current_mirror

* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror (Sky130 1.8 V devices).
*
* Each reference (icc_ref, iptat_ref) drives its own self-biased wide-swing
* cascode mirror, so the two inputs are fully independent:
*   pin -> R -> nb (bottom-mirror gate); pin is also the cascode gate.
*   Reference stack: LVT cascode (gate=pin, drain=nb) over bottom unit
*   (gate=nb). The low-Vt cascode plus I*R sets the bottom Vds (~0.2-0.3 V)
*   so the reference and output bottom devices see matched Vds, while the
*   pin stays near 0.7-0.85 V.
* Outputs use identical copies of the reference unit (exact ratios at all
* corners). Weights, with k = 2*b1 + b0:

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror (Sky130 1.8 V devices).
*
* Topology
* - Each reference pin drives its own self-biased wide-swing cascode branch:
*   pin -> R -> g (bottom-mirror gate) -> cascode -> bottom -> vss.  The pin
*   itself (V_GS1 + Iref*R) is the cascode gate bias, so no extra bias
*   current is drawn from vdd and the two references never share a node.
* - The output is built from replicated unit cells (bottom 72/1.5 + cascode
*   108/0.75, identical to the reference branch) summed at iout, so every
*   unit carries exactly one reference current at matched VDS.
* - Weights: ACC = 4 + 4*!b0 + 8*!b1, APTAT = 4 + 4*b0 + 8*b1 (sum = 20).
*   Switched segments steer their cascode gate between the bank bias (CMOS
*   transmission gate) and vss (pull-down); bottom gates stay connected, so
*   the reference pins are not disturbed by the code (gate-only loads).
*
* Unit cell (1x = one reference current): bottom w=72 nf=8 l=1.5,
* cascode w=108 nf=12 l=0.75 (9 um fingers, scaled by nf for ratios).
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout
* ---------------- control inverters ----------------
XIP0 b0n ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XIN0 b0n ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XIP1 b1n ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XIN1 b1n ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
* ---------------- ICC reference branch (1x) ----------------
RC icc_ref gc 4k
XRC3 gc icc_ref sc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=108 nf=12
XRC1 sc gc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=72 nf=8
* ---------------- IPTAT reference branch (1x) ----------------
RP iptat_ref gp 4k
XRP3 gp iptat_ref sp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=108 nf=12
XRP1 sp gp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=72 nf=8
* ---------------- ICC output bank ----------------
* fixed 4x
XOC0B xc0 gc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=288 nf=32
XOC0C iout icc_ref xc0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=432 nf=48
* 4x, on when b0=0
XSC1N cgc1 b0n icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XSC1P cgc1 ratio_b0 icc_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XSC1D cgc1 ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XOC1B xc1 gc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=288 nf=32
XOC1C iout cgc1 xc1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=432 nf=48
* 8x, on when b1=0
XSC2N cgc2 b1n icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XSC2P cgc2 ratio_b1 icc_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XSC2D cgc2 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XOC2B xc2 gc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=576 nf=64
XOC2C iout cgc2 xc2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=864 nf=96
* ---------------- IPTAT output bank ----------------
* fixed 4x
XOP0B xp0 gp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=288 nf=32
XOP0C iout iptat_ref xp0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=432 nf=48
* 4x, on when b0=1
XSP1N cgp1 ratio_b0 iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XSP1P cgp1 b0n iptat_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XSP1D cgp1 b0n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XOP1B xp1 gp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=288 nf=32
XOP1C iout cgp1 xp1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=432 nf=48
* 8x, on when b1=1
XSP2N cgp2 ratio_b1 iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XSP2P cgp2 b1n iptat_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XSP2D cgp2 b1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XOP2B xp2 gp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=576 nf=64
XOP2C iout cgp2 xp2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=864 nf=96

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror (Sky130 1.8 V devices).
*
* Output = 20 identical cascoded unit mirrors (unit = 50 uA at 1:1):
*   group A  4 units  always on ICC
*   group B  4 units  always on IPTAT
*   group C  8 units  ICC when ratio_b1=0, IPTAT when ratio_b1=1
*   group D  4 units  ICC when ratio_b0=0, IPTAT when ratio_b0=1
* so ACC = 16-8*b1-4*b0 and APTAT = 4+8*b1+4*b0 (ACC+APTAT = 20).
*
* Each reference has its own self-biased cascode: the reference current
* through R lifts the pin (= cascode gate) above the mirror gate, which sets
* the bottom-device Vds to about I*R minus the cascode body effect. A switched
* group moves both its mirror gate and its cascode gate to the selected side
* through CMOS transmission gates, so it copies that reference with the same
* Vds. The ICC and IPTAT paths share no bias node and no DC current flows
* through a switch, so neither pin voltage depends on the other reference or
* on the code.
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout
* ---- ICC reference: gcc = mirror gate, icc_ref = cascode gate
RCC icc_ref gcc 4.5k
XM3CC gcc icc_ref bcc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=200 nf=20
XM1CC bcc gcc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=200 nf=20
* ---- IPTAT reference: gpt = mirror gate, iptat_ref = cascode gate
RPT iptat_ref gpt 4.5k
XM3PT gpt iptat_ref bpt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=200 nf=20
XM1PT bpt gpt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=200 nf=20
* ---- control inverters (no static current)
XI0P b0n ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XI0N b0n ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XI1P b1n ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XI1N b1n ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* ---- group C gate steering (gc = mirror gate, kc = cascode gate)
XTCG1N gcc b1n gc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTCG1P gcc ratio_b1 gc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTCG2N gpt ratio_b1 gc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTCG2P gpt b1n gc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTCK1N icc_ref b1n kc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTCK1P icc_ref ratio_b1 kc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTCK2N iptat_ref ratio_b1 kc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTCK2P iptat_ref b1n kc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* ---- group D gate steering (gd = mirror gate, kd = cascode gate)
XTDG1N gcc b0n gd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTDG1P gcc ratio_b0 gd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTDG2N gpt ratio_b0 gd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTDG2P gpt b0n gd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTDK1N icc_ref b0n kd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTDK1P icc_ref ratio_b0 kd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTDK2N iptat_ref ratio_b0 kd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTDK2P iptat_ref b0n kd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* ---- output groups: 4-unit mirror + 4-unit cascode per instance pair
XMOA bao gcc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XMKA iout icc_ref bao vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XMOB bbo gpt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XMKB iout iptat_ref bbo vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XMOC1 bco gc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XMOC2 bco gc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XMKC1 iout kc bco vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XMKC2 iout kc bco vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XMOD bdo gd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XMKD iout kd bdo vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror (Sky130 1.8 V core devices).
*
* Architecture
*   Two independent cascode mirror chains, one per reference pin.  Each chain
*   takes its forced reference current through a level-shift resistor into a
*   diode-connected cascode/mirror pair: the top of the resistor (the pin) is
*   that chain's cascode gate bias, the bottom is that chain's mirror gate
*   bias.  Because the reference branch is itself cascoded, every output
*   segment is a 4x scaled replica of it (identical node voltages), so the
*   mirror weight is set by the width ratio alone.
*
*   Output side: four weight-4 segments per chain (200 uA nominal each).  One
*   segment per chain is always on; the other three are gate-switched by CMOS
*   decode logic with S1 = b0|b1, S2 = b1, S3 = b0&b1, giving
*     ACC   = 4*(1 + !S1 + !S2 + !S3) = 16, 12, 8, 4
*     APTAT = 4*(1 +  S1 +  S2 +  S3) =  4,  8, 12, 16
*   for codes 00, 01, 10, 11, so ACC + APTAT = 20 for every code.
*
*   Disabled segments have their mirror gate grounded and carry no static
*   current, so the output supplies all of the segment current.  Only gates
*   are switched, so both reference-pin voltages are code independent, and the
*   two chains share no analog node, so perturbing one reference does not move
*   the other reference pin.
*
* Bias sizing
*   The level-shift resistor carries the reference current, so the pin sits one
*   mirror Vgs plus I*R above vss: 0.83..1.00 V over the three signoff points
*   including the +/-5 uA perturbations (limit 0.20..1.10 V).  I*R also sets the
*   cascode source voltage, i.e. the mirror devices' Vds; 5 k on the constant
*   ICC chain and 4.2 k on the PTAT chain keep that near 0.14..0.25 V, above
*   Vdsat at every corner yet low enough that the output stays flat well below
*   the 0.45 V compliance floor.  Only vdd-referenced CMOS decode logic is tied
*   to vdd, so the auxiliary supply draws leakage only.

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- decode ---
.subckt pmc_inv vss vdd a y
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=2
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.7 nf=1
.ends pmc_inv

.subckt pmc_nand2 vss vdd a b y
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=2
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=2
XN1 y a nmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=2
XN2 nmid b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=2
.ends pmc_nand2

.subckt pmc_nor2 vss vdd a b y
XP1 pmid a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.8 nf=4
XP2 y b pmid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.8 nf=4
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.7 nf=1
XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.7 nf=1
.ends pmc_nor2

* ------------------------------------------------- reference branch (1x) ---
* Cascoded diode: vcasc is the pin (top of the level-shift resistor), vg is
* the mirror gate bias and carries the reference current into the cascode.
.subckt pmc_refdev vss vg vcasc
XMC vg vcasc mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=16
XMN mid vg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
.ends pmc_refdev

* --------------------------------------------- always-on segment (4x) ------
.subckt pmc_fixed vss vg vcasc iout
XMC iout vcasc mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=320 nf=64
XMN mid vg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=160 nf=32
.ends pmc_fixed

* --------------------------------------------- switched segment (4x) -------
* en high connects the segment mirror gate to vg through a transmission gate;
* en low grounds it.  No static current flows through the switch, so an
* enabled segment sees exactly vg.
.subckt pmc_seg vss vdd vg vcasc en enb iout
XSWP g enb vg vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XSWN g en vg vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPD g enb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMC iout vcasc mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=320 nf=64
XMN mid g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=160 nf=32
.ends pmc_seg

* ------------------------------------------------------------------ top ----
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout
* thermometer decode of the two-bit ratio code
XNOR1 vss vdd ratio_b0 ratio_b1 s1b pmc_nor2
XINVA vss vdd s1b s1 pmc_inv
XINVB vss vdd ratio_b1 s2b pmc_inv
XINVC vss vdd s2b s2 pmc_inv
XNAND1 vss vdd ratio_b0 ratio_b1 s3b pmc_nand2
XINVD vss vdd s3b s3 pmc_inv

* ICC chain: weight 4*(1 + !S1 + !S2 + !S3)
RLC icc_ref vgc 5k
XRC vss vgc icc_ref pmc_refdev
XCF vss vgc icc_ref iout pmc_fixed
XC1 vss vdd vgc icc_ref s1b s1 iout pmc_seg
XC2 vss vdd vgc icc_ref s2b s2 iout pmc_seg
XC3 vss vdd vgc icc_ref s3b s3 iout pmc_seg

* IPTAT chain: weight 4*(1 + S1 + S2 + S3)
RLP iptat_ref vgp 4.2k
XRP vss vgp iptat_ref pmc_refdev
XPF vss vgp iptat_ref iout pmc_fixed
XP1 vss vdd vgp iptat_ref s1 s1b iout pmc_seg
XP2 vss vdd vgp iptat_ref s2 s2b iout pmc_seg
XP3 vss vdd vgp iptat_ref s3 s3b iout pmc_seg
.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Top level:  vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout
*
* Each reference pin is forced with a current from vdd.  A diode-connected
* NMOS on each pin turns that current into a gate voltage; a bank of 20 unit
* output branches (main device + cascode) mirrors it into the iout sink.
* A 2-bit code steers 4-unit groups between the two gate rails, so
*   Iout = ACC*ICC + APTAT*IPTAT  with ACC+APTAT = 20.
*
* Cascode gate:  a symmetric resistor divider off both reference pins gives
* nxa = k*Vpin, and a diode-connected NMOS level shifter fed from vdd through
* a resistor makes ngb = nxa + Vgs.  The cascode source nodes, and therefore
* the output-device drains, then sit at ~nxa: low enough for the compliance
* sweep, set by resistors so the bias does not move with the small reference
* current perturbations used to measure the weights, and loaded identically
* on both pins so the two reference devices keep equal current density.
*
* The level shifter runs at the same current density as the output cascodes,
* so its Vgs cancels theirs and nxa alone sets the output drain voltage.
*
* Mirror devices use l=1um: a longer channel flattens I(Vds) over the 0.2-0.3V
* drain window the cascode holds, which keeps the mirror gain and the measured
* weights stable across the ss/tt/ff corners.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ======================= reference branches ================================
* Reference diodes.  Identical total width, so both pins sit at the same
* voltage and present the same current density to the mirror.
XMRC  icc_ref  icc_ref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=46.6 nf=4
XMRP  iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=46.6 nf=4

* ======================= cascode gate generation ===========================
* nxa = k*(Vicc + Viptat)/2 through a symmetric divider (no pin mismatch)
RDA   icc_ref   nxa 1meg
RDB   iptat_ref nxa 1meg
RDX   nxa       vss 62k
* Level shifter: ngb = nxa + Vgs at the output-cascode current density
RLB   vdd       ngb 330k
XMLB  ngb ngb nxa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.8 nf=1

* ====================== output unit groups =================================
* Group A: 4 units, always ICC
XMA   xa   icc_ref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=197 nf=4
XCA   iout ngb       xa  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=184 nf=16
* Group B: 4 units, always IPTAT
XMB   xb   iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=197 nf=4
XCB   iout ngb       xb  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=184 nf=16
* Group C1: 4 units, ICC when code /= 11
XMC1  xc1  g_c1      vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=197 nf=4
XCC1  iout ngb       xc1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=184 nf=16
* Group C2: 4 units, ICC when b1 = 0
XMC2  xc2  g_c2      vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=197 nf=4
XCC2  iout ngb       xc2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=184 nf=16
* Group C3: 4 units, ICC when code = 00
XMC3  xc3  g_c3      vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=197 nf=4
XCC3  iout ngb       xc3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=184 nf=16

* ====================== gate steering (dc only) ============================
XPS1A g_c1 s1  icc_ref   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XPS1B g_c1 s1b iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XPS2A g_c2 b1b icc_ref   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XPS2B g_c2 ratio_b1 iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XPS3A g_c3 s3  icc_ref   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XPS3B g_c3 s3b iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

* ====================== code decode logic ==================================
* b1b = inv(b1)
XIP1 b1b ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XIN1 b1b ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
* s1 = nand(b0,b1)
XPN1 s1 ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XPN2 s1 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNN1 s1 ratio_b0 nm1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XNN2 nm1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
* s1b = inv(s1)
XIP2 s1b s1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XIN2 s1b s1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
* s3 = nor(b0,b1)
XPP1 n3p ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XPP2 s3  ratio_b1 n3p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNP1 s3  ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XNP2 s3  ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
* s3b = inv(s3)
XIP3 s3b s3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XIN3 s3b s3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror
*
* Architecture
* ------------
* Each reference pin is terminated by a diode-connected NMOS unit device that
* converts the forced reference current into a mirror gate voltage.  The output
* current is the sum of 20 identical unit output devices, each of which mirrors
* one unit of reference current.  The ratio code steers the gates of three of
* the five 4-unit groups between the ICC and IPTAT gate nodes, so the ICC/IPTAT
* unit split is 16/4, 12/8, 8/12 or 4/16 while the total stays 20 units.
*
*   group A : 4 units, gate hard-wired to ICC     -> always ICC
*   group B : 4 units, gate hard-wired to IPTAT   -> always IPTAT
*   group C : 4 units, gate switched by b1        -> ICC when b1=0
*   group D : 4 units, gate switched by b0        -> ICC when b0=0
*   group E : 4 units, gate switched by b1        -> ICC when b1=0
*
*   code 00 -> ICC 4+4+4+4 = 16, IPTAT 4
*   code 01 -> ICC 4+4+0+4 = 12, IPTAT 4+4
*   code 10 -> ICC 4+0+4+0 =  8, IPTAT 4+4+4
*   code 11 -> ICC 4+0+0+0 =  4, IPTAT 4+4+4+4
*
* Each group drain feeds a cascode device biased by an internally generated
* gate voltage, which holds the output devices at a nearly constant drain
* voltage: this gives a very high small-signal output resistance and keeps the
* output current flat over the whole 0.45 V .. vdd-0.2 V compliance range.
* The cascode bias is generated by a resistor from vdd into a diode-connected
* NMOS whose current density is set so its gate sits roughly one Vdsat above
* the mirror gate voltage; it tracks Vth, temperature and process corner.
*
* All mirror devices share one geometry (l=8 w=160, W/L=20) so the mirror
* ratios are exact device-count ratios and every systematic effect cancels.

.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---------------- reference input diodes (1 unit each) ----------------
XMI  icc_ref   icc_ref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XPI  iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1

* ---------------- group A : 4 units, always ICC ----------------
XA1 ma icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XA2 ma icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XA3 ma icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XA4 ma icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XCA iout vcas ma vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=640 nf=4

* ---------------- group B : 4 units, always IPTAT ----------------
XB1 mb iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XB2 mb iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XB3 mb iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XB4 mb iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XCB iout vcas mb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=640 nf=4

* ---------------- group C : 4 units, gate switched by b1 ----------------
XC1 mc gc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XC2 mc gc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XC3 mc gc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XC4 mc gc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XCC iout vcas mc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=640 nf=4
XS1 icc_ref   nb1 gc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XS2 iptat_ref ratio_b1 gc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1

* ---------------- group D : 4 units, gate switched by b0 ----------------
XD1 md gd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XD2 md gd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XD3 md gd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XD4 md gd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XCD iout vcas md vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=640 nf=4
XS3 icc_ref   nb0 gd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XS4 iptat_ref ratio_b0 gd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1

* ---------------- group E : 4 units, gate switched by b1 ----------------
XE1 me ge vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XE2 me ge vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XE3 me ge vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XE4 me ge vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=1
XCE iout vcas me vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=640 nf=4
XS5 icc_ref   nb1 ge vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XS6 iptat_ref ratio_b1 ge vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1

* ---------------- code inverters (no static input current) ----------------
XI0N nb0 ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XI0P nb0 ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XI1N nb1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XI1P nb1 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* ---------------- cascode bias generator ----------------
RB vdd vcas 27.8k
XMB vcas vcas vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=10 nf=1

.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror.
*
* Two diode-connected NMOS devices convert the forced reference currents into
* gate voltages.  Five identical output blocks (each 4x the reference device)
* have their gates switched between icc_ref and iptat_ref by transmission-gate
* muxes.  With a thermometer code the block count on ICC is 4,3,2,1 while the
* block count on IPTAT is 1,2,3,4, so the output current is always
* 4*(n_icc*ICC + n_iptat*IPTAT) and the total nominal current is 20*50uA.
* A common cascode and a Vth-tracking bias branch set the output resistance.
*
* The reference pins only drive MOS gates (no DC current), so the code and
* the other reference do not disturb their operating points.

.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---------------- reference input diodes (1x) ----------------
XMI icc_ref icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=1
XMT iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=1

* ---------------- control logic ----------------
* nb1 = NOT(ratio_b1)
XINV1 nb1 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XINV1N nb1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
* nand1 = NAND(ratio_b1, ratio_b0)  (block 1 -> ICC unless code 11)
XNAND_P1 vdd ratio_b1 nand1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNAND_P2 vdd ratio_b0 nand1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNAND_N1 nand1 ratio_b1 nand_mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XNAND_N2 nand_mid ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XINV2 nand1b nand1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XINV2N nand1b nand1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
* nor1 = NOR(ratio_b1, ratio_b0)   (block 3 -> ICC only for code 00)
XNOR_P1 vdd ratio_b1 nor_mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNOR_P2 nor_mid ratio_b0 nor1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNOR_N1 nor1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XNOR_N2 nor1 ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XINV3 nor1b nor1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XINV3N nor1b nor1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------- output blocks (4x each) ----------------
* Block 0 always on ICC (C0 = 1, nC0 = 0)
XTG0_IN icc_ref vdd g0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XTG0_IP icc_ref vss g0 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XTG0_PN iptat_ref vss g0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XTG0_PP iptat_ref vdd g0 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XB0 x g0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=1

* Block 1 on ICC unless code 11 (C1 = NAND, nC1 = nand1b)
XTG1_IN icc_ref nand1 g1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XTG1_IP icc_ref nand1b g1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XTG1_PN iptat_ref nand1b g1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XTG1_PP iptat_ref nand1 g1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XB1 x g1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=1

* Block 2 on ICC when ratio_b1 = 0 (C2 = nb1, nC2 = ratio_b1)
XTG2_IN icc_ref nb1 g2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XTG2_IP icc_ref ratio_b1 g2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XTG2_PN iptat_ref ratio_b1 g2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XTG2_PP iptat_ref nb1 g2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XB2 x g2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=1

* Block 3 on ICC only for code 00 (C3 = NOR, nC3 = nor1b)
XTG3_IN icc_ref nor1 g3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XTG3_IP icc_ref nor1b g3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XTG3_PN iptat_ref nor1b g3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XTG3_PP iptat_ref nor1 g3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XB3 x g3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=1

* Block 4 always on IPTAT (C4 = 0, nC4 = 1)
XTG4_IN icc_ref vss g4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XTG4_IP icc_ref vdd g4 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XTG4_PN iptat_ref vdd g4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XTG4_PP iptat_ref vss g4 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XB4 x g4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=1

* ---------------- output cascode and Vth-tracking bias ----------------
XCAS iout vbias x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1000 nf=1
RBIAS vdd vbias 37.5k
XMB vbias vbias bmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=1
RTAIL bmid vss 20k

.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror
* Two reference currents are sensed by diode-connected NMOS devices.
* Four identical cells each contain 5 unit output devices.  Within each
* cell the number of devices steered to the ICC gate is 4,3,2,1 for codes
* 00,01,10,11; the remaining devices are steered to the IPTAT gate.
* Per cell: ACC + APTAT = 5, so the total is always 20 units.

* ---------------- inverter ----------------
.subckt pcm_inv vss vdd i o
XN o i vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP o i vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends pcm_inv

* ---------------- 2-input NAND ----------------
.subckt pcm_nand vss vdd a b o
XN1 o a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN2 n1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP1 o a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP2 o b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends pcm_nand

* ---------------- 2-input NOR ----------------
.subckt pcm_nor vss vdd a b o
XN1 o a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN2 o b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP1 o a n1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP2 n1 b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends pcm_nor

* ---------------- CMOS transmission gate ----------------
* en=1 connects a to b (enb is the complement of en)
.subckt pcm_tg vss vdd a b en enb
XTN a en b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XTP a enb b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends pcm_tg

* ---------------- one 5-unit cell ----------------
* Device j selects ICC for j=0..3 by code:
*   j1: NAND(b1,b0), j2: ~b1, j3: NOR(b1,b0)
* This gives 4,3,2,1 ICC units and 1,2,3,4 IPTAT units.
.subckt pcm_cell vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref n1 b1 s1 s1n s3 s3n vc out
* lower mirror device XU (d=vx g=sel s=vss), cascode XC (d=out g=vc s=vx)
* j = 0 : always ICC
XU0 vx0 icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=16 w=320 nf=8
XC0 out vc vx0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=16 w=320 nf=8
* j = 1
XU1 vx1 n1g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=16 w=320 nf=8
XC1 out vc vx1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=16 w=320 nf=8
XT1A vss vdd n1g icc_ref s1 s1n pcm_tg
XT1B vss vdd n1g iptat_ref s1n s1 pcm_tg
* j = 2 : ICC when b1 = 0
XU2 vx2 n2g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=16 w=320 nf=8
XC2 out vc vx2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=16 w=320 nf=8
XT2A vss vdd n2g icc_ref n1 b1 pcm_tg
XT2B vss vdd n2g iptat_ref b1 n1 pcm_tg
* j = 3
XU3 vx3 n3g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=16 w=320 nf=8
XC3 out vc vx3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=16 w=320 nf=8
XT3A vss vdd n3g icc_ref s3 s3n pcm_tg
XT3B vss vdd n3g iptat_ref s3n s3 pcm_tg
* j = 4 : always IPTAT
XU4 vx4 iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=16 w=320 nf=8
XC4 out vc vx4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=16 w=320 nf=8
.ends pcm_cell

* ---------------- top level ----------------
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout
* reference current sensing diodes (1:1 with the unit output devices)
XSICC icc_ref icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=16 w=320 nf=8
XSPT iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=16 w=320 nf=8

* ratio decode
XI1 vss vdd ratio_b1 nb1 pcm_inv
XN1 vss vdd ratio_b1 ratio_b0 s1 pcm_nand
XI2 vss vdd s1 s1n pcm_inv
XN2 vss vdd ratio_b1 ratio_b0 s3 pcm_nor
XI3 vss vdd s3 s3n pcm_inv

* cascode bias: R from vdd into a diode-connected NMOS whose W/L is
* smaller than the unit, approximating Vg + one overdrive.
RBIAS vdd vc 20k
XMB vc vc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=16 w=16 nf=1

* four cells, 5 units each -> 20 units total
XC0 vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref nb1 ratio_b1 s1 s1n s3 s3n vc iout pcm_cell
XC1 vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref nb1 ratio_b1 s1 s1n s3 s3n vc iout pcm_cell
XC2 vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref nb1 ratio_b1 s1 s1n s3 s3n vc iout pcm_cell
XC3 vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref nb1 ratio_b1 s1 s1n s3 s3n vc iout pcm_cell
.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror.
* Two diode-connected input mirrors set gate voltages from the forced
* reference currents.  Five identical output groups are weighted as four
* mirror units apiece (sized 4.2x the input unit to compensate the output
* devices' lower Vds): groups 0..3 are steered between the two reference
* gates by the ratio code, group 4 is a fixed IPTAT group.  A long-channel
* shared cascode raises the output resistance; its wide-swing gate bias comes
* from a supply-referenced resistor so reference weight measurements do not
* couple through the cascode.  Ratio logic uses static-current-free CMOS
* inverters and NMOS pass transistors.

.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---- reference diodes (1 mirror unit each, 40u/2u) ----
XMIN_ICC icc_ref icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=4
XMIN_PT  iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=4

* ---- five output mirror groups (168u/2u, 4.2 nominal units) ----
* group 0: always ICC
XM0 x icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=168 nf=16
* group 1: ICC when NOT(b1 AND b0)
XM1 x g1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=168 nf=16
* group 2: ICC when NOT(b1)
XM2 x g2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=168 nf=16
* group 3: ICC when (NOT b1) AND (NOT b0)
XM3 x g3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=168 nf=16
* group 4: fixed IPTAT (4 units)
XM4 x iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=168 nf=16

* ---- shared cascode output device ----
XCAS iout vbias_cas x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=800 nf=40

* ---- cascode bias generation ----
* Supply-referenced resistor current into a wide-swing bias diode.  It does
* not follow either forced reference, so the centered ICC/IPTAT weight
* measurement sees no cross-coupling through the cascode gate.
RBAIS vdd vbias_cas 68k
XDB   vbias_cas vbias_cas vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1.5 nf=1

* ---- control inverters (static-current free) ----
XI0N b0n ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XI0P b0n ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XI1N b1n ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XI1P b1n ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* ---- code mux for group 1: ICC = (b1=0) OR (b0=0), IPTAT = b1 AND b0 ----
XN1A icc_ref b1n g1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XN1B icc_ref b0n g1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XN1C iptat_ref ratio_b1 n1a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XN1D n1a ratio_b0 g1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* ---- code mux for group 2: ICC = NOT(b1), IPTAT = b1 ----
XN2A icc_ref b1n g2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XN2B iptat_ref ratio_b1 g2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* ---- code mux for group 3: ICC = (b1=0) AND (b0=0), IPTAT = b0 OR b1 ----
XN3A icc_ref b1n n3a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XN3B n3a b0n g3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XN3C iptat_ref ratio_b0 g3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XN3D iptat_ref ratio_b1 g3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror.
* Architecture: two self-biased cascoded mirror banks (ICC and IPTAT).
*   - icc_ref  pin -> R (5k) -> gate/drain of diode master (sinks IICC)
*   - iptat_ref pin -> R (4.5k) -> gate/drain of diode master (sinks IIPTAT)
*   - The reference-pin voltage is VGS + I*R and is used as the cascode
*     bias so every branch bottom sits at VDS = I*R (well within 0.45 V
*     compliance and in strong saturation across corners).
*   - Ratio control switches branch gate nodes between the mirror gate and
*     vss (no switches in the output current path):
*       ICC  on-branches  = 4 (always) + 4*(/b0) + 8*(/b1)
*       IPTAT on-branches = 4 (always) + 4*(b0)  + 8*(b1)
*     so ACC = 16..4 and APTAT = 4..16, ACC+APTAT = 20 for every code.
*   - Unit mirror width 94 um vs 90 um master compensates the systematic
*     saturating-device current deficit at the low branch VDS.
* All devices Sky130_fd_pr_ 1.8 V; only ideal R used.  No sources inside.
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---------------- ICC reference sense ----------------
Ricc icc_ref ng_icc 5k
Xicc ng_icc ng_icc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=90 nf=14

* ---------------- IPTAT reference sense ----------------
Rptat iptat_ref ng_ptat 4.5k
Xptat ng_ptat ng_ptat vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=90 nf=14

* ---------------- digital complements (/b0, /b1) ----------------
Xpb0 nb0 ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
Xnb0 nb0 ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
Xpb1 nb1 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
Xnb1 nb1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2

* ================ ICC bank (Vcas_icc = icc_ref node) ================
* Always-on branch, ratio 4 (bottom w=376, cascode w=376)
Xic_ba_bt i_y_icc_a ng_icc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=376 nf=56
Xic_ba_cs iout icc_ref i_y_icc_a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=376 nf=56

* /b0-gated branch, ratio 4
Xps0 g_icc0 nb0 ng_icc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
Xpo0 g_icc0 ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
Xic_bb_bt i_y_icc_b g_icc0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=376 nf=56
Xic_bb_cs iout icc_ref i_y_icc_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=376 nf=56

* /b1-gated branch, ratio 8
Xps1 g_icc1 nb1 ng_icc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
Xpo1 g_icc1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
Xic_bc_bt i_y_icc_c g_icc1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=752 nf=112
Xic_bc_cs iout icc_ref i_y_icc_c vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=752 nf=112

* ================ IPTAT bank (Vcas_ptat = iptat_ref node) ================
* Always-on branch, ratio 4
Xpt_ba_bt i_y_pt_a ng_ptat vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=376 nf=56
Xpt_ba_cs iout iptat_ref i_y_pt_a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=376 nf=56

* b0-gated branch, ratio 4
Xps2 g_pt0 ratio_b0 ng_ptat vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
Xpo2 g_pt0 nb0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
Xpt_bb_bt i_y_pt_b g_pt0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=376 nf=56
Xpt_bb_cs iout iptat_ref i_y_pt_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=376 nf=56

Xps3 g_pt1 ratio_b1 ng_ptat vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

Xpt_bc_bt i_y_pt_c g_pt1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=752 nf=112

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror (Sky130 1.8 V).
*
* Both references are forced into the DUT at icc_ref / iptat_ref and are
* absorbed by a diode-connected NMOS (the mirror's "gate bus").  The output
* is a segmented cascoded current mirror: each unit is an NMOS (gate = bus)
* stacked under a cascode NMOS whose gate is a single shared bias node Vcasc.
* The cascode keeps the mirror devices in saturation and raises the output
* impedance far above the required 100 kohm, while the shared bias node is
* generated by a small diode+resistor branch from vdd (Vth cancels, so the
* mirror headroom stays bounded across process/temperature corners).
*
* Ratio code  b1:b0   ACC   APTAT
*   00          0 0    16     4
*   01          0 1    12     8
*   10          1 0     8    12
*   11          1 1     4    16
* ACC + APTAT = 20 units; one unit = 1x the (50 uA @ 27 C) reference, so the
* 27 C output is 20 * 50 uA = 1 mA for every code.  Decomposition:
*   ACC   = 4 + 8*(1-b1) + 4*(1-b0)
*   APTAT = 4 + 8*b1      + 4*b0
*
* Cascoded mirror unit (ratio 1).  d = drain, g = mirror gate, c = cascode
* gate, s = vss.
.subckt pc d g c s
Xb nb g s s sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=32
Xc d c nb s sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=32
.ends pc

* Diode-connected reference input (mirror gate bus).  p = pin.
.subckt pd p s
Xd p p s s sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=32
.ends pd

* CMOS inverter (static logic complement, no static current).
.subckt inv in out vss vdd
Xp out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
Xn out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends inv

.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout
* Reference input sinks (diode-connected NMOS).
Xicc icc_ref vss pd
Xipt iptat_ref vss pd

* Shared cascode bias: vdd -> Rb -> vcasc -> diode -> vss.
Rb vdd vcasc 400k
Xbias vcasc vcasc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=0.5 nf=1

* Logic complements of the two ratio bits.
Xinv0 ratio_b0 nb0 vss vdd inv
Xinv1 ratio_b1 nb1 vss vdd inv

* 2:1 gate muxes for the mirror (bottom) gate only; cascode gate is shared.
*   bit = 0 -> gate follows icc_ref ;  bit = 1 -> gate follows iptat_ref
Xn0a icc_ref  nb0      g0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xn0b iptat_ref ratio_b0 g0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xn1a icc_ref  nb1      g1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xn1b iptat_ref ratio_b1 g1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* Fixed ICC contribution: 4 units.
Xicc0 iout icc_ref vcasc vss pc
Xicc1 iout icc_ref vcasc vss pc
Xicc2 iout icc_ref vcasc vss pc
Xicc3 iout icc_ref vcasc vss pc

* Fixed IPTAT contribution: 4 units.
Xipt0 iout iptat_ref vcasc vss pc
Xipt1 iout iptat_ref vcasc vss pc

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror (Sky130 1.8 V core + ideal R).
* Reference pins sink forced ICC/IPTAT through diode-connected 1x unit devices.
* Twenty 1x mirror units (4 fixed-ICC, 4 fixed-IPTAT, 12 switched in three
* 4-unit segments decoded from ratio_b<1:0>) sink the summed current off the
* internal node vn.  A wide NMOS cascode lifts rout far beyond the 100k target
* while holding vn at the mirror unit's saturation edge, and because the
* cascode gate is derived from an internal Vt-tracking bias network (never from
* either reference pin), perturbing a reference current moves neither vn nor
* the other reference: ACC/APTAT are read back as the exact on-device counts
* and the output current tracks ACC*ICC + APTAT*IPTAT over the full compliance
* range at all three PVT signoff points.
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---- output stage: cascode + Vt-tracking self bias ----
* Internal two-diode stack (same device as the references) plus a resistor tap
* sets the cascode gate at ~1.4*Vdiode: the tap tracks the corner (Vt) shift of
* the mirror devices, so vn sits near the unit Vov with a nearly constant margin
* at all three PVT points, while remaining completely independent of the two
* reference-pin voltages (no ACC/APTAT cross-coupling).
Xmc iout vbias vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=1000 nf=200
Rbias vdd nh 68k
Xbha nh nh nm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.5 w=45 nf=9
Xbla nm nm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.5 w=45 nf=9
Rdt nh vbias 360k
Rdb vbias nm 640k

* ---- ICC/IPTAT reference diodes (1x unit scale) ----

Xdp iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.5 w=45 nf=9

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror (Sky130).
* Combines a constant-current reference (ICC) and a PTAT reference (IPTAT)
* into one NMOS sink output.  A two-bit static code selects the mix:
*   b1:b0 = 00 -> 16*ICC +  4*IPTAT
*   b1:b0 = 01 -> 12*ICC +  8*IPTAT
*   b1:b0 = 10 ->  8*ICC + 12*IPTAT
*   b1:b0 = 11 ->  4*ICC + 16*IPTAT
* Total weight is always 20, so with both references at 50 uA the output
* is 1 mA at 27 C.
*
* Topology: long-channel (l=8) segmented mirror with W/L=64 (w=512, nf=80,
* w/nf=6.4 um).  A low overdrive (small Vov) keeps the mirror both accurate
* and linear versus the forced reference current, which keeps the measured
* ACC/APTAT weights within a few percent of the ideal table.  Every output
* unit is a bottom mirror device stacked under a cascode device; a shared
* cascode gate bias (resistor + diode -> Vc = Vth + Vov_d) holds the bottoms
* saturated down to 0.45 V while giving Rout >> 100 kOhm.
* Segmentation: 4 fixed ICC + 4 fixed IPTAT + an 8-unit group steered by b1
* + a 4-unit group steered by b0.  Steering uses NMOS pass gates driven by
* the bit and a CMOS inverter, so the low reference voltage (~0.60 V) is
* passed cleanly (a PMOS pass would be cut off by body effect at this level).
*
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* --- reference input diodes (set the mirror gate voltages) ---
XDICC icc_ref  icc_ref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XDIPT iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80

* --- shared cascode gate bias (resistor + diode -> Vc = Vth + Vov_d) ---
RVC vdd vc 77k
XDVC vc vc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=10 nf=2

* --- inverters for the two ratio bits ---
XINVP1 not_b1 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XINVN1 not_b1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XINVP0 not_b0 ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XINVN0 not_b0 ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* --- fixed 4x ICC output (bottom mirror + cascode) ---
XMBI1 micc1 icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMCI1 iout  vc      micc1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMBI2 micc2 icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMCI2 iout  vc      micc2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMBI3 micc3 icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMCI3 iout  vc      micc3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMBI4 micc4 icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMCI4 iout  vc      micc4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80

* --- fixed 4x IPTAT output (bottom mirror + cascode) ---
XMBT1 mipt1 iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMCT1 iout  vc        mipt1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMBT2 mipt2 iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMCT2 iout  vc        mipt2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMBT3 mipt3 iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMCT3 iout  vc        mipt3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMBT4 mipt4 iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMCT4 iout  vc        mipt4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80

* --- 8-unit group, bottom gate steered between icc_ref and iptat_ref by b1 ---
XMB8a m8a ng8 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMC8a iout vc  m8a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMB8b m8b ng8 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMC8b iout vc  m8b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMB8c m8c ng8 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMC8c iout vc  m8c vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMB8d m8d ng8 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMC8d iout vc  m8d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMB8e m8e ng8 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMC8e iout vc  m8e vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMB8f m8f ng8 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMC8f iout vc  m8f vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMB8g m8g ng8 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMC8g iout vc  m8g vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMB8h m8h ng8 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMC8h iout vc  m8h vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
* NMOS pass gates: icc_ref selected when b1=0, iptat_ref when b1=1
XNSC1 icc_ref  not_b1 ng8 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XNSI1 iptat_ref ratio_b1 ng8 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* --- 4-unit group, bottom gate steered between icc_ref and iptat_ref by b0 ---
XMB4a m4a ng4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMC4a iout vc  m4a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMB4b m4b ng4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMC4b iout vc  m4b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMB4c m4c ng4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMC4c iout vc  m4c vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMB4d m4d ng4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XMC4d iout vc  m4d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=512 nf=80
XNSC0 icc_ref  not_b0 ng4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XNSI0 iptat_ref ratio_b0 ng4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
* Uses resistor-shifted low-voltage cascode NMOS mirrors for ICC and IPTAT
* with replicated 1x unit cells and gate-switched binary-weighted branches
* (weights: 4x fixed, 4x controlled by ratio_b0, 8x controlled by ratio_b1).

.subckt inv_cell vss vdd in out
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends inv_cell

* Gate multiplexer: connects g_out to g_ref when en=vdd (en_b=vss), or to vss when en=vss (en_b=vdd)
.subckt gate_sw vss vdd g_ref en en_b g_out
XTG_N g_out en   g_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XTG_P g_out en_b g_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XPD   g_out en_b vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
.ends gate_sw

* Fundamental 1x cascode mirror unit cell (50uA nominal at 27C)
.subckt unit_branch_1x vss g_bot g_cas iout
XBOT d_bot g_bot vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=20 nf=4
XCAS iout  g_cas d_bot vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=56 nf=14
.ends unit_branch_1x

* Replicated 4x cascode mirror branch (4 * 1x unit cell = 200uA nominal)
.subckt mirror_branch_4x vss g_bot g_cas iout
XU0 vss g_bot g_cas iout unit_branch_1x
XU1 vss g_bot g_cas iout unit_branch_1x
XU2 vss g_bot g_cas iout unit_branch_1x
XU3 vss g_bot g_cas iout unit_branch_1x
.ends mirror_branch_4x

* Replicated 8x cascode mirror branch (2 * 4x branch = 400uA nominal)
.subckt mirror_branch_8x vss g_bot g_cas iout
XB0 vss g_bot g_cas iout mirror_branch_4x
XB1 vss g_bot g_cas iout mirror_branch_4x
.ends mirror_branch_8x

.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout
* Digital control inverters:
* b0_n is HIGH when ratio_b0=0; b0_p is HIGH when ratio_b0=1
XINV_B0_1 vss vdd ratio_b0 b0_n inv_cell
XINV_B0_2 vss vdd b0_n     b0_p inv_cell

* b1_n is HIGH when ratio_b1=0; b1_p is HIGH when ratio_b1=1
XINV_B1_1 vss vdd ratio_b1 b1_n inv_cell
XINV_B1_2 vss vdd b1_n     b1_p inv_cell

* ---------------- ICC Reference Stage (1x unit = 50uA) ----------------
RICC icc_ref g_icc 2.5k
XICC_REF vss g_icc icc_ref g_icc unit_branch_1x

* ---------------- IPTAT Reference Stage (1x unit = 50uA at 27C) ----------------
RIPTAT iptat_ref g_iptat 2.5k
XIPTAT_REF vss g_iptat iptat_ref g_iptat unit_branch_1x

* ---------------- Gate Switches for Programmable Branches ----------------
* ICC b0 branch (weight 4 when b0=0 -> en=b0_n, en_b=b0_p)
XSW_ICC_B0_BOT vss vdd g_icc   b0_n b0_p g_icc_b0_bot gate_sw
XSW_ICC_B0_CAS vss vdd icc_ref b0_n b0_p g_icc_b0_cas gate_sw

* ICC b1 branch (weight 8 when b1=0 -> en=b1_n, en_b=b1_p)
XSW_ICC_B1_BOT vss vdd g_icc   b1_n b1_p g_icc_b1_bot gate_sw
XSW_ICC_B1_CAS vss vdd icc_ref b1_n b1_p g_icc_b1_cas gate_sw

* IPTAT b0 branch (weight 4 when b0=1 -> en=b0_p, en_b=b0_n)
XSW_IPTAT_B0_BOT vss vdd g_iptat   b0_p b0_n g_iptat_b0_bot gate_sw
XSW_IPTAT_B0_CAS vss vdd iptat_ref b0_p b0_n g_iptat_b0_cas gate_sw

* IPTAT b1 branch (weight 8 when b1=1 -> en=b1_p, en_b=b1_n)
XSW_IPTAT_B1_BOT vss vdd g_iptat   b1_p b1_n g_iptat_b1_bot gate_sw
XSW_IPTAT_B1_CAS vss vdd iptat_ref b1_p b1_n g_iptat_b1_cas gate_sw

* ---------------- Output Mirror Branches ----------------
* Fixed branches (always ON: 4x ICC + 4x IPTAT)
XBR_ICC_FIX   vss g_icc          icc_ref        iout mirror_branch_4x
XBR_IPTAT_FIX vss g_iptat        iptat_ref      iout mirror_branch_4x

* Programmable b0 branches (4x ICC when b0=0, 4x IPTAT when b0=1)
XBR_ICC_B0    vss g_icc_b0_bot   g_icc_b0_cas   iout mirror_branch_4x
XBR_IPTAT_B0  vss g_iptat_b0_bot g_iptat_b0_cas iout mirror_branch_4x

* Programmable b1 branches (8x ICC when b1=0, 8x IPTAT when b1=1)
XBR_ICC_B1    vss g_icc_b1_bot   g_icc_b1_cas   iout mirror_branch_8x
XBR_IPTAT_B1  vss g_iptat_b1_bot g_iptat_b1_cas iout mirror_branch_8x

.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror

.subckt inv_cell vss vdd in out
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.0 nf=1
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.0 nf=1
.ends inv_cell

* Unit mirror slice with weight=4 (4 * 50uA = 200uA nominal)
* Reference transistor has nf=2 (bot) and nf=4 (cas), so weight=4 has nf=8 and nf=16
