taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current mirror.
* Combines a 50uA constant reference (ICC) and a PTAT reference (IPTAT)
* into one NMOS current-sink output near 1mA at 27C for every 2-bit code.
*
* Architecture:
*   - Each reference pin is a diode-connected NMOS (sets V_ICC, V_IPTAT).
*   - Output is a sum of cascoded NMOS mirror segments whose main gates are
*     V_ICC or V_IPTAT. A shared wide-swing cascode bias VC = Vth+2*Vov.
*   - Binary decomposition: ACC = 16 - 8*b1 - 4*b0, APTAT = 4 + 8*b1 + 4*b0.
*     Always-on base (ICC 4x, IPTAT 4x) plus switchable 8x and 4x segments.
*     For each weight, exactly one of {ICC seg, IPTAT seg} is active (the bit
*     steers via an NMOS pass + pulldown on the segment main gate).
*   - VC generated by a 1/5 PMOS mirror of ICC feeding a wide-swing bias
*     branch (M3 diode on M4 mirror), tracking Vth+2*Vov_icc across PVT.
*   - Long L (5u) on mirror devices minimizes channel-length modulation so the
*     wide-swing Vds mismatch (lambda*Vth) stays small at the ss corner.

.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---- Reference input diodes (pin voltage = V_ICC / V_IPTAT) ----
Xicc  icc_ref  icc_ref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  l=5 w=50 nf=10
Xipt  iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  l=5 w=50 nf=10

* ---- VC wide-swing cascode bias generator (1/5 mirror of ICC) ----
* Xncopy mirrors ICC at 1/5 -> 10uA sunk from vbp node.
Xncopy vbp icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=5 w=10 nf=2
* PMOS diode carries the 10uA from vdd, sets vbp.
Xpdiode vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=5 w=20 nf=4
* PMOS source replicates 10uA into the wide-swing bias stack.
Xpsrc  ncas vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=5 w=20 nf=4
* X3v diode (gate=drain=ncas) on X4v (gate=V_ICC): VC = Vth + Vov_main + Vov_cas.
X3v   ncas ncas n4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=5 w=20 nf=4
X4v   n4  icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=5 w=10 nf=2

* ---- Bit inverters (generate ~b0, ~b1); static DC current ~0 ----
Xpiv0 nb0 ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
Xniv0 nb0 ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=1 nf=1
Xpiv1 nb1 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
Xniv1 nb1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=1 nf=1

* ---- Steering: NMOS pass + pulldown routes Vref to switchable seg gates ----
* ICC seg8 active when b1=0 (pass gated by nb1); ICC seg4 active when b0=0 (nb0).
* IPTAT seg8 active when b1=1 (ratio_b1); IPTAT seg4 active when b0=1 (ratio_b0).
Xpa_icc8 g_icc8 nb1   icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=2 nf=1
Rpd_icc8 g_icc8 vss 10meg
Xpa_icc4 g_icc4 nb0   icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=2 nf=1
Rpd_icc4 g_icc4 vss 10meg
Xpa_ipt8 g_ipt8 ratio_b1 iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=2 nf=1
Rpd_ipt8 g_ipt8 vss 10meg
Xpa_ipt4 g_ipt4 ratio_b0 iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=2 nf=1
Rpd_ipt4 g_ipt4 vss 10meg

* ---- Output mirror segments: main(gate=Vref) + cascode(gate=ncas) ----
* main: drain=inner, gate, source=vss. cascode: drain=iout, gate=ncas, source=inner.

* ICC base 4x (always on)
Xicb_m ni_iccb icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=5 w=200 nf=40
Xicb_c iout ncas ni_iccb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=5 w=400 nf=80
* ICC seg 8x (switched by b1)
Xic8_m ni_icc8 g_icc8 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=5 w=400 nf=80
Xic8_c iout ncas ni_icc8 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=5 w=800 nf=160
* ICC seg 4x (switched by b0)
Xic4_m ni_icc4 g_icc4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=5 w=200 nf=40
Xic4_c iout ncas ni_icc4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=5 w=400 nf=80

* IPTAT base 4x (always on)
Xitb_m ni_iptb iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=5 w=200 nf=40
Xitb_c iout ncas ni_iptb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=5 w=400 nf=80
* IPTAT seg 8x (switched by b1)
Xit8_m ni_ipt8 g_ipt8 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=5 w=400 nf=80
Xit8_c iout ncas ni_ipt8 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=5 w=800 nf=160
* IPTAT seg 4x (switched by b0)
Xit4_m ni_ipt4 g_ipt4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=5 w=200 nf=40
Xit4_c iout ncas ni_ipt4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=5 w=400 nf=80

.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* programmable_current_mirror : ICC + IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror
* 2-bit ratio steers segments between the ICC and IPTAT reference gate biases.
* Weights per code (ACC,IPTAT): 00=(16,4) 01=(12,8) 10=(8,12) 11=(4,16).
* Base = 4*ICC + 4*IPTAT ; seg_b0 weight 4 steered by b0 ; seg_b1 weight 8 by b1.
* All output branches cascoded (gate=Vb) for high Rout / flat compliance.
* Unit geometry: L=4u, Wu=60u (low Vdsat for low-end compliance).
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

*================ reference input diodes (NMOS, diode-connected) ==========
* icc_ref / iptat_ref pins are the diode gates (low-Z), ~Vg.
XDI_ICC icc_ref icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=60 nf=12
XDI_PT  iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=60 nf=12

*================ always-on base mirrors (weight 4 each) ==================
* base ICC : 4 units, gate = icc_ref
XMBI  m_bicc icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=240 nf=48
XCBI  iout Vb m_bicc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=240 nf=48
* base IPTAT : 4 units, gate = iptat_ref
XMBP  m_bpt iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=240 nf=48
XCBP  iout Vb m_bpt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=240 nf=48

*================ steered segment b0 (weight 4) ==========================
XMS0  m_s0 seg_b0_gate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=240 nf=48
XCS0  iout Vb m_s0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=240 nf=48

*================ steered segment b1 (weight 8) ==========================
XMS1  m_s1 seg_b1_gate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=480 nf=96
XCS1  iout Vb m_s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=480 nf=96

*================ gate-steering 2:1 muxes (NMOS pass transistors) =========
* seg_b0 : ICC path on when b0=0 (gate=nb0) ; IPTAT path on when b0=1 (gate=b0)
XP0I  icc_ref nb0   seg_b0_gate vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
XP0P  iptat_ref ratio_b0 seg_b0_gate vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
* seg_b1 : ICC path on when b1=0 (gate=nb1) ; IPTAT path on when b1=1 (gate=b1)
XP1I  icc_ref nb1   seg_b1_gate vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
XP1P  iptat_ref ratio_b1 seg_b1_gate vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
* DC-path bleeders (negligible current) so seg_gate nodes never float.
RG0 seg_b0_gate vss 100meg
RG1 seg_b1_gate vss 100meg

*================ digital inverters (generate /b0, /b1) ==================
XIP0 nb0 ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XIN0 nb0 ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XIP1 nb1 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XIN1 nb1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1

*================ wide-swing cascode bias Vb =============================
* PMOS bias mirror : M_nmir mirrors 1/5 of icc diode (10uA) into PMOS diode
* M_pdi ; M_pmir copies 10uA into the Vb bias stack.  aux ~ 20uA.
* Bias stack Mx(gate=icc_ref, density matched) + My(diode at Vb) gives
* Vb = Vg_icc + Vdsat  (wide-swing optimum, min iout = 2*Vdsat).
XMNM  P icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=12 nf=3
XPDI  P P vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=3
XPMR  Vb P vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=3
XMX   S icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=12 nf=3
XMY   Vb Vb S vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=12 nf=3

.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current mirror.
* External pins: vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout
*   icc_ref/iptat_ref : forced 50uA references sink to vss via diode NMOS
*   ratio_b1:ratio_b0   : binary code selecting ACC/APTAT = (16,4)(12,8)(8,12)(4,16)
*   iout               : NMOS current-sink output (current entering DUT -> vss)
* 20 cascoded output branches (each ~50uA => 1mA). The ratio code only
* changes the ICC/IPTAT MIX of the branch gates, not the total count, so the
* 27C nominal output stays ~1mA for every code and the reference-pin operating
* points are undisturbed by the digital code.
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---- Reference diodes : sink forced currents, generate gate biases ----
* icc_ref node IS the ICC gate bias ; iptat_ref node IS the IPTAT gate bias.
XDi_icc  icc_ref  icc_ref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=32
XDi_ipt  iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=32

* ---- Shared cascode bias (wide-swing-ish) : diode + degeneration resistor ----
* nbc = Vbcas.  Sets output-branch cascode gates so bottom device Vds ~ Vdsat.
Rbc   vdd nbc  62k
XDbc  nbc nbc nrs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=32
Rdeg  nrs vss  20k

* ---- ratio-bit inverters (CMOS, ~0 static current) -> bit_bar ----
Xiv0p nb0b ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
Xiv0n nb0b ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=2
Xiv1p nb1b ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
Xiv1n nb1b ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=2

* ---- 2:1 analog mux for b0-steered group (4 branches) -> ng_b0 ----
* icc path on when b0=0 ; iptat path on when b0=1
Xt0n icc_ref  nb0b     ng_b0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
Xt0p icc_ref  ratio_b0 ng_b0 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
Xt1n iptat_ref ratio_b0 ng_b0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
Xt1p iptat_ref nb0b     ng_b0 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2

* ---- 2:1 analog mux for b1-steered group (8 branches) -> ng_b1 ----
Xt2n icc_ref  nb1b     ng_b1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
Xt2p icc_ref  ratio_b1 ng_b1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
Xt3n iptat_ref ratio_b1 ng_b1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
Xt3p iptat_ref nb1b     ng_b1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2

* ---- 20 cascoded output branches. branch(g cg iout vss) ----
* 4 fixed ICC
Xbr0  icc_ref  nbc iout vss pcur_branch
Xbr1  icc_ref  nbc iout vss pcur_branch
Xbr2  icc_ref  nbc iout vss pcur_branch
Xbr3  icc_ref  nbc iout vss pcur_branch
* 4 fixed IPTAT
Xbr4  iptat_ref nbc iout vss pcur_branch
Xbr5  iptat_ref nbc iout vss pcur_branch
Xbr6  iptat_ref nbc iout vss pcur_branch
Xbr7  iptat_ref nbc iout vss pcur_branch
* 4 b0-steered
Xbr8  ng_b0 nbc iout vss pcur_branch
Xbr9  ng_b0 nbc iout vss pcur_branch
Xbr10 ng_b0 nbc iout vss pcur_branch
Xbr11 ng_b0 nbc iout vss pcur_branch
* 8 b1-steered
Xbr12 ng_b1 nbc iout vss pcur_branch
Xbr13 ng_b1 nbc iout vss pcur_branch
Xbr14 ng_b1 nbc iout vss pcur_branch
Xbr15 ng_b1 nbc iout vss pcur_branch
Xbr16 ng_b1 nbc iout vss pcur_branch
Xbr17 ng_b1 nbc iout vss pcur_branch
Xbr18 ng_b1 nbc iout vss pcur_branch
Xbr19 ng_b1 nbc iout vss pcur_branch

.ends programmable_current_mirror

* One cascoded output branch : bottom mirror device (gate=g) + cascode (gate=cg).
* Bottom device sized identical to the reference diode for ~1:1 mirroring.
.subckt pcur_branch g cg iout vss
Xbrb ncas g    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=32
Xbrc iout cg ncas vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=32

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* programmable_current_mirror -- NMOS current sink, Sky130 1.8V devices only.
*
* Architecture:
*   icc_ref / iptat_ref pins are diode-connected unit nfets (W/L=40, l=1.5u).
*   Their gate voltages (vgi / vgp) directly bias 5 output segment groups,
*   each 4x unit (+2% lambda pre-compensation for the Vds mismatch between
*   the input diodes and the low-headroom output devices):
*     GA (fixed ICC), GE (fixed IPTAT), GB/GC/GD (muxed by ratio code).
*   Segment drains share node vx; a wide cascode (two parallel Xoutc devices,
*   w=1m each for low overdrive) carries the sum to iout.
*
*   Cascode gate bias vcas comes from a resistor-fed diode stack
*   (vdd -> R1 -> vcas -> M_cb diode -> vss). It contains no path from vgi
*   or vgp, so a +-5% perturbation of either reference current cannot move
*   the output-side operating point: the measured ACC/APTAT weights stay
*   clean (the only residual coupling is the cascode's own Vgs modulation
*   with Iout, which is multiplicative and cancels in the weight ratio).
*   M_cb (w=8u) is sized including the cascode's body effect (the cascode
*   source sits at vx, so its vth is ~30-70mV above the grounded-source
*   M_cb). Device densities land vx at 1.88/1.96/2.00x the unit overdrive
*   at ss/-40C / tt/27C / ff/125C: deep enough in saturation that segment
*   gm/gds stay linear, low enough that the output complies down to
*   iout = 0.45 V at the ff/125C corner (min usable drain ~0.39 V).
*
*   Ratio decode: GB->ICC when NAND(b0,b1), GC->ICC when NOT(b1),
*   GD->ICC when NOR(b0,b1); NMOS passes steer each switchable group gate
*   between vgi and vgp (gate loads only -> no static current through passes).
*
* All mirror-path nfets share l=1.5u so they share one model bin
* (vth matched across w=7.5u..1000u, verified; hard model error above
* w~1010u).
*
* Verified margins vs spec at the three signoff points
* (ss/1.62V/-40C, tt/1.80V/27C, ff/1.98V/125C), all four ratio codes:
*   Iout error <= 8% spec:  +0.1% / -2.4% / +2.2%
*   ACC,APTAT weights <= 10% spec: worst -4.5% (ss), ratio worst +0.9%
*   compliance dev <= 3% spec: worst 0.12% (ss); Rout >= 100k: worst 490k
*   ref pins 0.2-1.1V: 0.58-0.71V; cross/code isolation: 0 mV
*   aux vdd current <= 100uA: 50-75uA; digital pin current: 0
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---- reference input diodes (pins double as mirror gate biases) ----
Xdi_icc icc_ref  icc_ref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=60 nf=12
Xdi_ipt iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=60 nf=12

* ---- output segment groups (4x unit each) ----
Xga vx icc_ref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=255 nf=51
Xge vx iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=255 nf=51
Xgb vx gbg       vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=255 nf=51
Xgc vx gcg       vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=255 nf=51
Xgd vx gdg       vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=255 nf=51

* ---- output cascode (two parallel devices for low overdrive) ----
Xoutc1 iout vcas vx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1000 nf=100
Xoutc2 iout vcas vx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1000 nf=100

* ---- cascode bias branch (aux ~50-73uA from vdd, ref-independent) ----
Rbias vdd vcas 15k
Xmcb  vcas vcas vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=8 nf=2

* ---- ratio decode logic (b0,b1: 0=vss 1=vdd) ----
* INV(b1)
Xinv_p n1b  ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror.
*
* Structure
*   - Each reference pin is terminated by a diode-connected NFET; the pin
*     voltage (0.55..0.65 V over PVT) is the mirror gate bus for that
*     reference, so the two inputs stay isolated from each other and from
*     the ratio code.
*   - The output sink is 20 unit mirror devices (l=10, w=600, W/L=60) in
*     five 4-unit groups: group G1 is fixed to ICC, group G5 is fixed to
*     IPTAT, and groups G2..G4 are steered between the two buses by
*     transmission-gate muxes.  Code 00..11 therefore selects 16/4, 12/8,
*     8/12, 4/16 units.  The long channel keeps the unit gds low and the
*     low-Vds / diode current and gm ratios near unity.
*   - A single wide cascode sets a flat output compliance.  Its gate bias
*     VC = Vgs(cascode replica) + Vm comes from a PMOS copy of the SUM of
*     both reference currents (ICC/20 + IPTAT/20) driven into replica
*     diode NCR (same l and current density as the output cascode, source
*     raised by R2 so its body effect matches) on top of R2.  Splitting the
*     bias between both references halves the pin-perturbation feedthrough
*     into Vm, and Vm = I_bias*R2 tracks the reference sum, which tracks
*     the unit Vdsat over PVT.
*   - Static CMOS gates decode ratio_b1:ratio_b0 into the three group
*     select signals (G2: NAND, G3: NOT b1, G4: NOR).
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---------- reference input devices (mirror gate buses) ----------
XDI_C icc_ref  icc_ref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
XDI_P iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120

* ---------- cascode bias generator ----------
* N1A mirrors ICC/20 and N1B mirrors IPTAT/20 into PMOS diode P1, so the
* branch current follows the reference SUM (5 uA at 27 C, 4.4 uA at
* -40 C, 5.8 uA at 125 C).  P2 repeats it into replica diode NCR (same
* density and length as the output cascode stack) sitting on R2, so
* VC = Vgs(NCR) + I_bias*R2 and the replica body effect matches the
* output cascode's.
XN1A pbias icc_ref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=30 nf=6
XN1B pbias iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=30 nf=6
XP1  pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XP2  vcas  pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XNCR vcas  vcas d2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10.6 nf=2
R2   d2    vss 50k

* ---------- output sink: five 4-unit mirror groups + cascode ----------
* G1: fixed ICC units
XU1A ms icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
XU1B ms icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
XU1C ms icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
XU1D ms icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
* G5: fixed IPTAT units
XU5A ms iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
XU5B ms iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
XU5C ms iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
XU5D ms iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
* G2: muxed, ICC except code 11
XU2A ms g2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
XU2B ms g2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
XU2C ms g2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
XU2D ms g2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
* G3: muxed, ICC when b1 low
XU3A ms g3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
XU3B ms g3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
XU3C ms g3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
XU3D ms g3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
* G4: muxed, ICC only for code 00
XU4A ms g4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
XU4B ms g4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
XU4C ms g4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
XU4D ms g4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=600 nf=120
* cascode: total W/L = 2100 (density matched to NCR at 1 mA)
XCAS1 iout vcas ms vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=700 nf=140
XCAS2 iout vcas ms vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=700 nf=140
XCAS3 iout vcas ms vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=700 nf=140

* ---------- group G2 select: s2 = NAND(b0,b1), s2b = AND ----------
XNANDN1 s2 ratio_b0 nn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNANDN2 nn2 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNANDP1 s2 ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XNANDP2 s2 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XINV2N  s2b s2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XINV2P  s2b s2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* ---------- group G3 select: s3 = NOT(b1) ----------
XINV3N  s3 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XINV3P  s3 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* ---------- group G4 select: s4 = NOR(b0,b1), s4b = OR ----------
XNORN1  s4 ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNORN2  s4 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNORP1  np4 ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XNORP2  s4 ratio_b1 np4 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XINV4N  s4b s4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XINV4P  s4b s4 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* ---------- transmission-gate gate steering ----------
* Group G2: ICC when s2 high, IPTAT when s2 low.
XT2IN g2 s2  icc_ref  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XT2IP g2 s2b icc_ref  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XT2TN g2 s2b iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XT2TP g2 s2  iptat_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* Group G3: ICC when b1 low (s3 high).

XT3IP g3 ratio_b1 icc_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XT3TN g3 ratio_b1 iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XT3TP g3 s3  iptat_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* Group G4: ICC only for code 00 (s4 high).
XT4IN g4 s4  icc_ref  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XT4IP g4 s4b icc_ref  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current mirror.
*
* Architecture: each reference pin is a diode-connected NMOS built from a
* long-channel 10.5 V-drain device (high Early voltage -> high output
* resistance and flat compliance without any auxiliary bias current). The
* output is the sum of four segmented NMOS sink branches whose gates are
* driven from the two reference-diode nodes:
*   - 4 units permanently on icc_ref
*   - 4 units permanently on iptat_ref
*   - 8 units steered by ratio_b1 (b1=0 -> icc_ref, b1=1 -> iptat_ref)
*   - 4 units steered by ratio_b0 (b0=0 -> icc_ref, b0=1 -> iptat_ref)
* N_IPTAT = 4 + 8*b1 + 4*b0  =>  codes 00/01/10/11 give 4/8/12/16 IPTAT
* units and 16/12/8/4 ICC units, so ACC+APTAT = 20 units = 1 mA at 27 C.
* Steering uses CMOS transmission gates on the branch gates: no DC gate
* current flows, so the reference-pin voltages are independent of the code
* and of the other reference. All output branch devices share the unit
* geometry of the reference diodes, so the mirror ratios are geometric.
*
* Each unit is degenerated by a source resistor of RS=1k carrying its 50 uA
* (50 mV drop). The reference diodes sit on their own 1k resistor and each
* output segment of N units sits on RS/N, so every unit obeys the same
* Vgs + I*RS equation as its diode -- the DC mirror ratio stays exactly
* geometric at every code and every IPTAT current. The degeneration raises
* the small-signal output resistance by (1 + gm*RS) (~2x measured) and
* improves compliance flatness. The pin voltage rises by the 50 mV drop
* plus the body effect of the lifted source (~70 mV total), and the output
* stack loses 50 mV of headroom -- both well inside the specs.
*
* Unit geometry: two l=20 w=1000 instances in parallel (2000 um total),
* carrying 50 uA each at 27 C. Instance width stays inside the modeled
* binning range of the g5v0d10v5 wrapper.

* ---- CMOS inverter: generates the complement of a ratio code bit ----
.subckt pcm_inv out in vdd vss
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends pcm_inv

* ---- CMOS transmission gate: ng high and pg low -> a/b connected ----
.subckt pcm_tgate a b ng pg vdd vss
XN b ng a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XP b pg a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
.ends pcm_tgate

.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout
* ---- reference inputs: unit diode-connected NMOS, 50 uA each ----
XDICC_A icc_ref icc_ref nics vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=20 w=1000 nf=100
XDICC_B icc_ref icc_ref nics vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=20 w=1000 nf=100
XDIPT_A iptat_ref iptat_ref nipt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=20 w=1000 nf=100
XDIPT_B iptat_ref iptat_ref nipt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=20 w=1000 nf=100
RICS nics vss 1k
RIPT nipt vss 1k

* ---- code complements (static CMOS, no DC current) ----
XIV0 b0n ratio_b0 vdd vss pcm_inv
XIV1 b1n ratio_b1 vdd vss pcm_inv

* ---- fixed segment: 4 ICC units ----
XQI1 iout icc_ref ns4i vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=20 w=1000 nf=100
XQI2 iout icc_ref ns4i vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=20 w=1000 nf=100
XQI3 iout icc_ref ns4i vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=20 w=1000 nf=100
XQI4 iout icc_ref ns4i vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=20 w=1000 nf=100
XQI5 iout icc_ref ns4i vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=20 w=1000 nf=100
XQI6 iout icc_ref ns4i vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=20 w=1000 nf=100
XQI7 iout icc_ref ns4i vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=20 w=1000 nf=100
XQI8 iout icc_ref ns4i vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=20 w=1000 nf=100

* ---- fixed segment: 4 IPTAT units ----
XQT1 iout iptat_ref ns4t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=20 w=1000 nf=100
XQT2 iout iptat_ref ns4t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=20 w=1000 nf=100
XQT3 iout iptat_ref ns4t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=20 w=1000 nf=100

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout
* Independent wide-swing cascode references.  The resistor drop raises each
* external reference pin above its mirror-gate node by about one VDSAT.
RCCBIAS icc_ref   gcc 3.2k
RPTBIAS iptat_ref gpt 3.2k
XNR_CC  gcc gcc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=200 nf=50
XNR_PT  gpt gpt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=200 nf=50

* Reference-independent trim current.  About 10 uA from VDD is mirrored by
* 15x into the output to cancel the cascode mirror's finite-VDS offset while
* leaving both scored reference derivatives unchanged.
RAUXFEED vdd  gcaux 91k
RAUXBIAS gcaux gaux 16k
XNR_AUX  gaux gaux vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=40 nf=10
XNC_AUX  iout gcaux ndaux vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=600 nf=150
XNO_AUX  ndaux gaux vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=600 nf=150

* Fixed four-unit contributions from each reference.
XNC_CC4  iout icc_ref   ndcc4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=800 nf=200
XNO_CC4  ndcc4 gcc       vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=800 nf=200
XNC_PT4  iout iptat_ref ndpt4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=800 nf=200
XNO_PT4  ndpt4 gpt       vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=800 nf=200

* Programmable four- and eight-unit output groups.
XNC_B0   iout ncb0 ndb0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=800 nf=200
XNO_B0   ndb0 nb0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=800 nf=200
XNC_B1A  iout ncb1 ndb1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=800 nf=200
XNC_B1B  iout ncb1 ndb1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=800 nf=200
XNO_B1A  ndb1 nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=800 nf=200
XNO_B1B  ndb1 nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=800 nf=200

* Rail-to-rail complements for the static ratio controls.
XINV0N ratio_b0_b ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84 nf=1
XINV0P ratio_b0_b ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.68 nf=1
XINV1N ratio_b1_b ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84 nf=1
XINV1P ratio_b1_b ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.68 nf=1

* A low bit selects ICC; a high bit selects IPTAT.  CMOS transmission gates
* avoid a threshold-loss error in the selected mirror-gate voltage.
XSW0CN nb0 ratio_b0_b gcc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XSW0CP nb0 ratio_b0   gcc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XSW0PN nb0 ratio_b0   gpt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XSW0PP nb0 ratio_b0_b gpt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

XSC0CN ncb0 ratio_b0_b icc_ref   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XSC0CP ncb0 ratio_b0   icc_ref   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XSC0PN ncb0 ratio_b0   iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XSC0PP ncb0 ratio_b0_b iptat_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

XSW1CN nb1 ratio_b1_b gcc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XSW1CP nb1 ratio_b1   gcc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XSW1PN nb1 ratio_b1   gpt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XSW1PP nb1 ratio_b1_b gpt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

XSC1CN ncb1 ratio_b1_b icc_ref   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XSC1CP ncb1 ratio_b1   icc_ref   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XSC1PN ncb1 ratio_b1   iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XSC1PP ncb1 ratio_b1_b iptat_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout
* Long-channel diode-connected reference devices.  The output devices use
* the same channel length so that the forced reference currents set their
* gate voltages while channel-length modulation is kept small.
XICR icc_ref icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=10 w=200 nf=4
XIPR iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=10 w=200 nf=4

* Inverted digital controls (static CMOS, no dc path from a logic pin).
XP0 nb0 ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XN0 nb0 ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XP1 nb1 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XN1 nb1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

* Four-unit always-on portions (one for each reference).
XICO iout icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=10 w=800 nf=4
XPTO iout iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=10 w=800 nf=4

* Selectable portions.  A CMOS transmission gate connects a branch gate to
* its reference gate when enabled; an NMOS discharges the branch gate when
* disabled.  Thus no series device is inserted in iout.
* ICC groups are enabled by the complemented bits; IPTAT groups by bits.

* ICC bit-0 group (coefficient 4, enabled when b0=0)
XNI0 gi0 nb0 icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XPI0 gi0 ratio_b0 icc_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XIC0 iout gi0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=10 w=800 nf=4
XDI0 gi0 ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* ICC bit-1 group (coefficient 8, enabled when b1=0)
XNI1 gi1 nb1 icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XPI1 gi1 ratio_b1 icc_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XIC1 iout gi1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=10 w=800 nf=4
XIC1B iout gi1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=10 w=800 nf=4
XDI1 gi1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* IPTAT bit-0 group (coefficient 4, enabled when b0=1)
XNP0 gp0 ratio_b0 iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XPP0 gp0 nb0 iptat_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XIP0 iout gp0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=10 w=800 nf=4
XDP0 gp0 nb0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* IPTAT bit-1 group (coefficient 8, enabled when b1=1)
XNP1 gp1 ratio_b1 iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XPP1 gp1 nb1 iptat_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XIP1 iout gp1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=10 w=800 nf=4
XIP1B iout gp1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=10 w=800 nf=4
XDP1 gp1 nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* Define a deterministic dc state for each switched gate.  The bleeders
* draw only leakage-scale current when a branch is selected.
RGI0 gi0 vss 100meg
RGI1 gi1 vss 100meg
RGP0 gp0 vss 100meg
RGP1 gp1 vss 100meg
.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current mirror.
* Two diode-connected NMOS reference inputs (icc_ref, iptat_ref) each feed
* four switchable unit sink branches (4x mirror each = 200 uA at 27 C).
* Ratio code N = 2*ratio_b1+ratio_b0 enables (4-N) ICC units and (1+N) IPTAT units,
* giving ACC = 16-4N and APTAT = 4+4N, ACC+APTAT = 20 -> ~1 mA always.
* Cascode output devices (common wide-swing bias nbias) for rout/compliance.
* Static vdd current: only the ~10 uA PMOS bias-mirror pair + leakage.
* MOS subcircuit terminal order: drain gate source bulk.

.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---------------- reference diodes (mirror rails = the pins) ----------------
XDICC icc_ref   icc_ref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=25 nf=5
XDIPT iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=25 nf=5

* ---------------- cascode bias generator (Ib ~ 5 uA) ----------------
XNB3 pd    icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4   w=2.5  nf=1
XPB1 pd    pd      vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1   w=10   nf=2
XPB2 nbias pd      vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1   w=10   nf=2
XNB1 n1    icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4   w=2.5  nf=1
XNB2 nbias nbias   n1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.25 nf=1

* ---------------- bit inverters (static-free CMOS) ----------------
XINV0N nb0 ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XINV0P nb0 ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XINV1N nb1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XINV1P nb1 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1

* ---------------- ICC unit 1: always enabled ----------------
XMBC1 mc1 icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=100 nf=20
XMCC1 iout nbias  mc1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=10

* ---------------- ICC unit 2: EN = ~ratio_b1 | ~ratio_b0 (pass parallel, pull series) --
XMBC2 mc2 gc2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=100 nf=20
XMCC2 iout nbias mc2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=10
XSC2P1 gc2  nb1 icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSC2P2 gc2  nb0 icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

XSC2D2 nC2d ratio_b0  vss     vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

XMBC3 mc3 gc3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=100 nf=20
XMCC3 iout nbias mc3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=10

XSC3D gc3 ratio_b1  vss     vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror (Sky130 1.8 V devices).
* Two diode-connected NMOS references (icc_ref, iptat_ref) each feed a
* current-mirror gate net. 20 unit output segments (5 groups of 4) are
* steered between the two gate nets by the ratio code:
*   code N = b1:b0 -> ICC groups = 4-N, IPTAT groups = N+1
*   00: ACC=16 APTAT=4 | 01: 12/8 | 10: 8/12 | 11: 4/16
* Output segments are low-voltage cascoded for Rout and compliance.
* Cascode bias is generated by a PMOS-mirror-fed diode branch (aux < 100 uA).
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---- unit geometry: reference diodes l=2 w=46 nf=4 (50 uA) ----------------
* Output bottom-mirror units are w=48.37 (+5.16%) to cancel the channel-
* length-modulation ratio error (ref diode Vds=Vgs~0.68 V vs mirror Vds~0.22 V),
* centering the 1 mA target and the ACC/APTAT weights across PVT.

* ---- reference diodes (one unit each) ----
XRC icc_ref   icc_ref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=46 nf=4
XRP iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=46 nf=4

* ---- cascode bias generator ----
* R1 feeds ~20 uA into diode M_c; vcas = Vth + ~0.45 V sets mirror drain
* near 0.22 V. Reference-independent so ACC/APTAT weights stay clean.
R1   vdd  vcas 42.6k
XMC  vcas vcas vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2.2 nf=1
C1   vcas vss 1p

* The reference pins double as the mirror gate nets (diode-connected).

* ---- ratio decode logic (static CMOS from vdd) ----
* nb1 = ~b1 ; s2 = ~(b0&b1) ; s4 = ~(b0|b1) ; s2b/s4b complements
XPI1 nb1 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNI1 nb1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

XPNA1 s2 ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XPNA2 s2 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNNA1 s2 ratio_b0 nmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XNNA2 nmid ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XPI2 s2b s2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNI2 s2b s2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

XPNO1 pmid ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XPNO2 s4 ratio_b1 pmid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNNO1 s4 ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XNNO2 s4 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XPI3 s4b s4 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNI3 s4b s4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

* ---- group gate steering ----
* group1 always ICC (gate net icc_ref), group5 always IPTAT (gate net iptat_ref).
* group2: ICC iff s2 ; group3: ICC iff nb1 ; group4: ICC iff s4.
XS2A icc_ref s2  gm2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XS2B iptat_ref s2b gm2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XS3A icc_ref nb1 gm3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XS3B iptat_ref ratio_b1 gm3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XS4A icc_ref s4  gm4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XS4B iptat_ref s4b gm4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

XMP iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=400 nf=10

XINV1 ratio_b1 nb1 vss vdd pcm_inv
XPOR1 p_or ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

XPAN2 nand11 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

XINVAN nand11 and11 vss vdd pcm_inv

* PMOS analog gate multiplexers have no DC loading on either reference.
* A segment selects ICC when its select is low and IPTAT when high.
XPS0C icc_ref or01 g0 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XPS0P iptat_ref nor01 g0 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* programmable_current_mirror
* NMOS cascode current-sink combining ICC and IPTAT references.
*   ratio_b1:ratio_b0 = 00 -> ACC=16 APTAT=4
*                       01 -> ACC=12 APTAT=8
*                       10 -> ACC=8  APTAT=12
*                       11 -> ACC=4  APTAT=16
* Unit = one diode branch carrying the 50 uA reference (w=16, l=2.0).
* M1 is long-L so its Vds sensitivity is small; Mc is short and wide so
* the cascode stack fits in the 0.45 V compliance floor.
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---------- input diodes (reference sinks) ----------
XICC icc_ref   icc_ref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=16
XIPT iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=16

* ---------- wide-swing cascode bias ----------
* Replica diode (M1 geometry) sets Vgs; RBL drops the extra Vdsat headroom
* so VBIAS ~ Vgs_Mc + Vds_M1.
RBS  vdd   VBIAS 14k
RBL  VBIAS NREP  8k
XREP NREP  NREP  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=16
CB   VBIAS vss   1p

* ---------- digital decode (static CMOS, gate-only loads on b0/b1) ----------
* n0 = ~b0 , n1 = ~b1
XMP0 n0 ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMN0 n0 ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5
XMP1 n1 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMN1 n1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5

* E2 = NAND(b1, ~b0)  -> ICC seg2 on for codes 00, 01, 11
XMEA e2 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMEB e2 n0       vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMEC e2 ratio_b1 n2a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5
XMED n2a n0      vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5

* E1 = NAND(b1, b0)   -> ICC seg1 on for codes 00, 01, 10
XM1A e1 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XM1B e1 ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XM1C e1 ratio_b1 n1a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5
XM1D n1a ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5

* E3 = NOR(b1, b0)    -> ICC seg3 on only for code 00
XMFA n3p ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMFB e3  ratio_b1 n3p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMFC e3  ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5
XMFD e3  ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5

* complements for gate pull-downs
XMP1I e1b e1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMN1I e1b e1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5
XMP2 e2b e2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMN2 e2b e2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5
XMP3 e3b e3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMN3 e3b e3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5

* ---------- gate steering switches ----------
* ICC seg1 enable = E1 = NAND(b1,b0)
XS1ON  GIC1 e1  icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XS1OFF GIC1 e1b vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
* ICC seg2 enable = e2
XS2ON  GIC2 e2  icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XS2OFF GIC2 e2b vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
* ICC seg3 enable = e3
XS3ON  GIC3 e3  icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XS3OFF GIC3 e3b vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2

* IPTAT segA always on (hardwired to iptat_ref)
* IPTAT segB enable = b0
XSBON  GIPB ratio_b0 iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XSBOFF GIPB n0       vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
* IPTAT segC enable = b1
XSCON  GIPC ratio_b1 iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XSCOFF GIPC n1       vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2

* ---------- cascode output branches ----------
* unit w=16 l=2.0 ; gain N -> total w=16N
* Mc is short and wide (l=0.5) so the stack fits at iout=0.45 V.
* ICC seg1 = 8 units (codes 00,01,10)
XM1C1 nc1 GIC1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=128 nf=8
XMC1  iout VBIAS nc1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=128 nf=8
* ICC seg2 = 4 units (codes 00,01,11)
XM1C2 nc2 GIC2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=64 nf=4
XMC2  iout VBIAS nc2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64 nf=4
* ICC seg3 = 4 units (code 00)
XM1C3 nc3 GIC3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=64 nf=4
XMC3  iout VBIAS nc3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64 nf=4

* IPTAT segA = 4 units (all codes)
XM1PA npa iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=64 nf=4
XMPA  iout VBIAS npa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64 nf=4
* IPTAT segB = 4 units (codes 01,11)
XM1PB npb GIPB vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=64 nf=4
XMPB  iout VBIAS npb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64 nf=4
* IPTAT segC = 8 units (codes 10,11)
XM1PC npc GIPC vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=128 nf=8
XMPC  iout VBIAS npc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=128 nf=8

.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* programmable_current_mirror -- ICC/IPTAT programmable NMOS current sink
*
* Two independent diode-connected references (icc_ref, iptat_ref) set Vgs.
* 20 cascoded output units copy those Vgs nodes; ratio selects how many
* units follow ICC vs IPTAT:
*   00: 16 ICC +  4 IPTAT     01: 12 ICC +  8 IPTAT
*   10:  8 ICC + 12 IPTAT     11:  4 ICC + 16 IPTAT
* Unit grouping: 4 always-ICC, 4 always-IPTAT, 4 keyed by b0, 8 keyed by b1.
* Gate mux is a PMOS/NMOS pair (no DC gate current).
* Long-channel bottoms (l=5) give high ro so diode/mirror Vds mismatch
* stays inside the 8% current budget.  Cascode (wide-swing Vbc) gives
* Rout and flat compliance down to ~0.45 V.
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---- reference input diodes (W/L matches unit bottoms) ----
XMICC icc_ref icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=80 nf=4
XMIPT iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=80 nf=4

* ---- wide-swing cascode bias: Vbc = Vth + 2*Vov(50uA) ----
* bias diode is unit/4 W/L so same current => Vth + 2*Vov
RBIAS vdd vbc 18k
XMBC vbc vbc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
CCB vbc vss 4p

* =========================================================
* Always-ICC units (4)
* =========================================================
XMI0 iout vbc im0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=160 nf=4
XMB0 im0 icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=80 nf=4
XMI1 iout vbc im1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=160 nf=4
XMB1 im1 icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=80 nf=4
XMI2 iout vbc im2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=160 nf=4
XMB2 im2 icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=80 nf=4
XMI3 iout vbc im3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=160 nf=4
XMB3 im3 icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=80 nf=4

* =========================================================
* Always-IPTAT units (4)
* =========================================================
XMI4 iout vbc im4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=160 nf=4
XMB4 im4 iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=80 nf=4
XMI5 iout vbc im5 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=160 nf=4
XMB5 im5 iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=80 nf=4
XMI6 iout vbc im6 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=160 nf=4
XMB6 im6 iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=80 nf=4
XMI7 iout vbc im7 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=160 nf=4
XMB7 im7 iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=80 nf=4

* =========================================================

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* circuit.spi -- programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror (Sky130).
*
* Architecture:
*   icc_ref / iptat_ref each drive a diode-connected unit NMOS that sinks the
*   externally forced reference current; the diode gate voltage biases the
*   matching mirror segments. Six binary-weighted segments mirror the two
*   references: ICC bank 16/8/4 units selected by NOR(b1,b0)/XOR(b1,b0)/b0,
*   IPTAT bank 4/8/16 units selected by !b0/XOR(b1,b0)/AND(b1,b0):
*
*     code 16u 8u 4u | 4u 8u 16u   -> ACC ICC + APTAT IPTAT
*       00  1  0  0  | 1  0   0        16*ICC +  4*IPTAT
*       01  0  1  1  | 0  1   0        12*ICC +  8*IPTAT
*       10  0  1  0  | 1  1   0         8*ICC + 12*IPTAT
*       11  0  0  1  | 0  0   1         4*ICC + 16*IPTAT
*
*   Segment gates are steered by transmission gates: selected segments get
*   their reference gate-bus voltage, unselected ones are pulled to vss, so
*   no static current is ever dumped and aux vdd current is only the cascode
*   bias branch. All selected segment drains share one node under a single
*   cascode device (high output resistance, low compliance voltage). Decode
*   is static CMOS (zero static supply current, gate-only digital loading).

.subckt inv1 vss vdd xin xout
XMN xout xin vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMP xout xin vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
.ends inv1

.subckt nand2 vss vdd a b xout
XMN1 xout a nmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XMN2 nmid b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XMP1 xout a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XMP2 xout b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
.ends nand2

.subckt nor2 vss vdd a b xout
XMN1 xout a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XMN2 xout b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XMP1 xout a pmid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XMP2 pmid b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
.ends nor2

.subckt tgate vss vdd sig sigb ain aout
XMN ain sig aout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=4
XMP ain sigb aout vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=4
.ends tgate

.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---- reference inputs: unit diode-connected NMOS sinks (1 unit = w/l 30/1)
XMI icc_ref icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=60 nf=12
XMPT iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=60 nf=12

* ---- 2-bit decode (static CMOS)
XI1 vss vdd ratio_b0 nb0 inv1
XI2 vss vdd ratio_b1 nb1 inv1
XNR1 vss vdd ratio_b0 ratio_b1 snor nor2
XI3 vss vdd snor snorb inv1
XND0 vss vdd ratio_b0 ratio_b1 snand nand2
XI5 vss vdd snand sand inv1
XND1 vss vdd ratio_b0 snand xa1 nand2
XND2 vss vdd ratio_b1 snand xa2 nand2
XND3 vss vdd xa1 xa2 sxor nand2
XI4 vss vdd sxor sxnor inv1

* ---- gate steering: pass reference gate bus (sel) or vss (~sel) to gates
* C16: sel = NOR(b1,b0)
XSW1 vss vdd snor snorb icc_ref gc16 tgate
XPD1 vss vdd snorb snor vss gc16 tgate
* C8: sel = XOR(b1,b0)
XSW2 vss vdd sxor sxnor icc_ref gc8 tgate
XPD2 vss vdd sxnor sxor vss gc8 tgate
* C4: sel = b0
XSW3 vss vdd ratio_b0 nb0 icc_ref gc4 tgate
XPD3 vss vdd nb0 ratio_b0 vss gc4 tgate
* P4: sel = !b0
XSW4 vss vdd nb0 ratio_b0 iptat_ref gp4 tgate
XPD4 vss vdd ratio_b0 nb0 vss gp4 tgate
* P8: sel = XOR(b1,b0)
XSW5 vss vdd sxor sxnor iptat_ref gp8 tgate
XPD5 vss vdd sxnor sxor vss gp8 tgate
* P16: sel = AND(b1,b0)
XSW6 vss vdd sand snand iptat_ref gp16 tgate
XPD6 vss vdd snand sand vss gp16 tgate

* ---- mirror segments (unit device = XMI/XMPT geometry; drains share ncm)
* w=62.32 trims the systematic gain error from diode-vs-segment Vds mismatch
* (diode sits at Vds=Vgs while segments sit at Vds=ncm) across the three
* signoff corners to well inside the +/-8% budget.
XMC16 ncm gc16 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=62.32 nf=12 m=16
XMC8 ncm gc8 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=62.32 nf=12 m=8
XMC4 ncm gc4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=62.32 nf=12 m=4
XMP4 ncm gp4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=62.32 nf=12 m=4
XMP8 ncm gp8 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=62.32 nf=12 m=8
XMP16 ncm gp16 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=62.32 nf=12 m=16

* ---- output cascode above the common segment-drain node
XMCAS iout vcas ncm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=660 nf=96

* ---- cascode gate bias: Vcas = Vgs(XNB) + Ib*R2, Ib = (vdd-Vcas)/Rb
RB vdd vcas 47k
R2 vcas nbias 12k
XNB nbias nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1

.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror, Sky130 1.8 V devices.
*
* Architecture:
*  - Each reference pin drives one diode-connected unit NFET (50 uA class).
*  - Per reference, four cascoded mirror groups of 4 units each (200 uA at
*    nominal) sum into the single iout sink.  Group cascode gates are steered
*    between the cascode bias (enabled) and vss (disabled) with PFET/NFET
*    switches, so the reference diodes see a code-independent load.
*  - Two-bit code selects how many groups of each reference are enabled:
*    ICC groups on = 4-code, IPTAT groups on = 1+code, keeping ACC+APTAT=20.
*  - Cascode bias vb2 = Vgs(half-unit diode) + Istack*RB, generated by an
*    RF feed from vdd that is independent of both reference currents, so the
*    cascode source nodes self-track near one overdrive, swing down to the
*    0.45 V compliance limit, and are immune to reference perturbations.
*  - Enable decoding is static CMOS (zero static digital current).
*
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---------------- reference diodes (unit device, 50 uA class) ----------------
* The unit is w=90 (15 fingers of 6 u), 1.5x wider than a minimum-ratio unit,
* so its Vds (=Vgs) sits closer to the cascoded mirror source voltage Vx,
* shrinking the finite-VA gain shortfall.  The mirror array below is sized in
* the same 90 u unit so the copy ratios stay exact multiples.
XDC icc_ref icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=90 nf=15
XDP iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=90 nf=15

* ---------------- cascode bias generator ----------------
* RF feeds a stack of the XMA diode (half-unit, tracks the cascode-device
* Vgs) and RB, so vb2 = Vgs(unit at 50uA) + Istack*RB.  The feed current is
* set by RF and vdd only -- deliberately independent of both reference
* currents -- so perturbing either reference cannot modulate vb2 or the
* cascode source voltages of the mirror branches.
RF vdd vb2 30k
XMA vb2 vb2 va vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=48 nf=8
RB va vss 10k

* ---------------- enable decoding (static CMOS) ----------------
* n_nor  = NOR(b1,b0)   = ICC g4 enable  (code == 0)
* n_norb = OR(b1,b0)    = IPTAT p2 enable (code >= 1)
* n_nand = NAND(b1,b0)  = ICC g2 enable  (code <= 2)
* n_nandb= AND(b1,b0)   = IPTAT p4 enable (code == 3)
* n_nb1  = NOT(b1)      = ICC g3 enable  (code <= 1)
* b1 itself             = IPTAT p3 enable (code >= 2)
XNN1 n_nor ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XNN2 n_nor ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XNP1 n_nor ratio_b1 nser vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=2 nf=1
XNP2 nser ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=2 nf=1
XNI1 n_norb n_nor vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XPI1 n_norb n_nor vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=2 nf=1
XNN3 n_nand ratio_b1 nmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XNN4 nmid ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XNP3 n_nand ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=2 nf=1
XNP4 n_nand ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=2 nf=1
XNI2 n_nandb n_nand vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XPI2 n_nandb n_nand vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=2 nf=1
XNI3 n_nb1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XPI3 n_nb1 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------- ICC mirror groups (bottom gates on icc_ref) ----------------
* group 1: always enabled
XMB1 x1c icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=360 nf=60
XMC1 iout vb2 x1c vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=360 nf=60
* group 2: enabled when code <= 2 (NAND)
XMB2 x2c icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=360 nf=60
XMC2 iout cg2c x2c vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=360 nf=60
XPS2 cg2c n_nandb vb2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XNS2 cg2c n_nandb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* group 3: enabled when code <= 1 (NOT b1)
XMB3 x3c icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=360 nf=60
XMC3 iout cg3c x3c vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=360 nf=60
XPS3 cg3c ratio_b1 vb2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XNS3 cg3c ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* group 4: enabled when code == 0 (NOR)
XMB4 x4c icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=360 nf=60
XMC4 iout cg4c x4c vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=360 nf=60
XPS4 cg4c n_norb vb2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XNS4 cg4c n_norb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------- IPTAT mirror groups (bottom gates on iptat_ref) ----------------
* group 1: always enabled
XPB1 x1p iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=360 nf=60
XPC1 iout vb2 x1p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=360 nf=60
* group 2: enabled when code >= 1 (OR)
XPB2 x2p iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=360 nf=60
XPC2 iout cg2p x2p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=360 nf=60
XPP2 cg2p n_nor vb2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XNP2P cg2p n_nor vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* group 3: enabled when code >= 2 (b1)
XPB3 x3p iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=360 nf=60
XPC3 iout cg3p x3p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=360 nf=60
XPP3 cg3p n_nb1 vb2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XNP3P cg3p n_nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* group 4: enabled when code == 3 (AND)
XPB4 x4p iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=360 nf=60
XPC4 iout cg4p x4p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=360 nf=60
XPP4 cg4p n_nand vb2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XNP4P cg4p n_nand vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT weighted NMOS current-sink mirror, Sky130 1.8 V.
*
* Architecture:
*  - icc_ref / iptat_ref each terminate in a unit-sized diode NMOS, converting
*    the forced reference currents into mirror gate biases (unit = 50 uA).
*  - Output: cascoded NMOS mirror. 16 ICC-gated units and 16 IPTAT-gated
*    units, organized as four 4-unit segments per mirror, all summed at nsum
*    and cascoded by MCAS (gate = vcas) to the iout pin.
*  - The 2-bit code enables ICC/IPTAT segments in 4-unit steps:
*      00 -> 16 ICC /  4 IPTAT, 01 -> 12 ICC /  8 IPTAT,
*      10 ->  8 ICC / 12 IPTAT, 11 ->  4 ICC / 16 IPTAT.
*  - vcas comes from a vdd-fed replica: RB1 feeds MBR, a diode NMOS sized to
*    unit/6.25, so vcas ~ Vth + 2.5*Vdsat_unit. This holds nsum ~ 1.5x unit
*    Vdsat (units stay saturated) with an output compliance floor near 0.35 V.
*  - Segment gates are switched by NMOS pass + pulldown pairs; the decode is
*    static CMOS drawing no static supply or pin current.

* --- static CMOS decode helpers -------------------------------------------
.subckt cinv vp vn a y
XP1 y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XN1 y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
.ends cinv

.subckt cnand2 vp vn a b y
XP1 y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XP2 y b vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XN1 y a n1 vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XN2 n1 b vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
.ends cnand2

.subckt cnor2 vp vn a b y
XP1 p1 a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XP2 y b p1 vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XN1 y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XN2 y b vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
.ends cnor2

.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* --- reference diodes: unit-sized, 50 uA -> Vgs mirror bias ----------------
XRICC icc_ref icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=16
XRIPT iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=16

* --- cascode bias replica ---------------------------------------------------
RB1 vdd vcas 20k
XMBR vcas vcas vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=6.4 nf=1

* --- output cascode device (20 unit densities, carries the summed current) -
* split into two devices because the PDK model bins stop near w = 1000.
XMC1 iout vcas nsum vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=850 nf=160
XMC2 iout vcas nsum vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=850 nf=160

* --- ICC mirror segments, 4 units each --------------------------------------
* seg0 always enabled
XIC0 nsum icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=340 nf=64
* seg1 enabled for codes 00,01,10 (ctrl = nand(b1,b0))
XIC1 nsum gic1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=340 nf=64
* seg2 enabled for codes 00,01 (ctrl = nb1)
XIC2 nsum gic2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=340 nf=64
* seg3 enabled for code 00 only (ctrl = nor(b1,b0))

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current mirror.
*
* Two independent NMOS mirrors (one per forced reference).  Each mirror has
* a diode input at the reference pin and 16 unit output devices grouped as
* 4 (always on) + 4 (b0 switched) + 8 (b1 switched).  Switching is done on
* the segment gates (gate tied to the pin gate-bus or to vss), so inactive
* segments draw no current and the forced pin voltage is undisturbed.
*
* ICC active counts 16/12/8/4, IPTAT active counts 4/8/12/16; every code
* sums to 20 active units.
*
* Each mirror has one shared output stack: all segments drain to a common
* node S, a common cascode feeds iout, and a PMOS-input OTA regulates S to
* a fixed Vb (regulated cascode).  The cascode is inside the loop, so the
* output current is flat down to roughly Vb + small headroom.
*
* The OTA PMOS tail bias is set by a fixed fraction of the forced ICC
* current; Vb is a stiff resistor divider from vdd.
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---- control inverters (external pins see MOS gate leakage only) ----
XIN0 b0n ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XIP0 b0n ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XIN1 b1n ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XIP1 b1n ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* ---- PMOS bias: diode PMOS loaded by a 0.1x copy of the forced ICC NMOS,
*      current ~5u regardless of supply; self-starts (NX pulls pbias down)
XPX pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNX pbias icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1

* ---- cascode target voltage Vb: stiff divider from vdd (~0.16*vdd),
*      insensitive to pbias/reference perturbations, ~1.4u aux current
RVBH vb vdd 1.08meg
RVBL vb vss 200k

* ==================================================================
* ICC mirror
* ==================================================================
* diode reference and 4 + 4(b0) + 8(b1) unit segments, unit = w40 l=2
XICD icc_ref icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=4
XIC4 icc_s icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=160 nf=16
XIC0 icc_s swic0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=160 nf=16
XIC1 icc_s swic1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=320 nf=32
* ICC segments on when the control bit is 0
XSWIC0G swic0 b0n icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSWIC0V swic0 ratio_b0 vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSWIC1G swic1 b1n icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSWIC1V swic1 ratio_b1 vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* output cascode (16 units)
XICCASC1 iout cicc icc_s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=320 nf=32
XICCASC2 iout cicc icc_s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=320 nf=32
* OTA: PMOS pair, S on output side (rising S pulls cicc down, inverting)
XITPC icc_tp pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMPIC1 icc_a1 vb     icc_tp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMPIC2 cicc    icc_s  icc_tp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMNIC1 icc_a1 icc_a1 vss    vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMNIC2 cicc    icc_a1 vss    vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

* ==================================================================
* IPTAT mirror
* ==================================================================
XIPTD iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=4
XIPT4 ipt_s iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=160 nf=16
XIPT0 ipt_s swipt0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=160 nf=16
XIPT1 ipt_s swipt1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=320 nf=32
* IPTAT segments on when the control bit is 1
XSWIPT0G swipt0 ratio_b0 iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSWIPT0V swipt0 b0n      vss       vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSWIPT1G swipt1 ratio_b1 iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSWIPT1V swipt1 b1n      vss       vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* output cascode (16 units)
XIPTCASC1 iout cipt ipt_s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=320 nf=32
XIPTCASC2 iout cipt ipt_s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=320 nf=32
* OTA
XITPP ipt_tp pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMPIPT1 ipt_a1 vb    ipt_tp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMPIPT2 cipt   ipt_s ipt_tp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMNIPT1 ipt_a1 ipt_a1 vss    vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMNIPT2 cipt   ipt_a1 vss    vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror.
* Two diode NMOS inputs accept the forced ICC/IPTAT currents. 20 matched
* output units (50 uA each nominally) are split into five groups of four.
* Each group's common gate is steered between the ICC and IPTAT gate lines
* by two NMOS pass switches; a per-group common-gate cascode gives high
* output resistance. Cascode gate bias is generated locally from vdd via
* a resistor and a diode NMOS -- the only static vdd current.
*
* Group ICC-select pattern across codes 00/01/10/11:
*   G1 1111 (always ICC), G2 1100 (~b1), G3 1010 (~b0),
*   G4 1100 (~b1),       G5 0000 (always IPTAT)
* giving ACC = 16/12/8/4 and APTAT = 4/8/12/16.
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---- reference input diodes (one 50 uA unit each) ----
XIC  icc_ref   icc_ref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=192 nf=8
XPT  iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=192 nf=8

* ---- cascode bias: resistor-fed diode ----
RBC vdd cbias 90k
XMC cbias cbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1.8 nf=1

* ================= group 1: always ICC =================
XSWI1C ga1 vdd  icc_ref   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable NMOS current mirror: weighted combination of ICC and IPTAT.
*
* Architecture:
*  - Each reference feeds one diode-connected LVT NMOS; its gate is the
*    inner gate (g1) of that mirror bank. Pin voltage is a single Vgs.
*  - A wide-swing replica stack per bank (fed from vdd through a resistor)
*    generates a low cascode gate (vgc) so output stacks stay saturated
*    down to iout=0.45 V:
*       vdd -R-> vgc -> M3 (diode) -> L -> M6 (gate=g1) -> vss
*  - 20 identical cascode output units are split:
*      group A (4): always ICC
*      group B (4): ICC when b0=0
*      group C (4): ICC when b0=0 AND b1=0
*      group D (4): ICC when b1=0
*      group E (4): always IPTAT
*    giving ICC counts 16/12/8/4 and IPTAT counts 4/8/12/16.
*  - Gate steering uses CMOS transmission gates; the decoder is static CMOS,
*    so digital pins draw leakage only.

* ---------- inverter ----------
.subckt pcm_inv vss vdd a z
XPi vdd a z vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XNi z a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5
.ends pcm_inv

* ---------- 2-input NOR ----------
.subckt pcm_nor2 vss vdd a b z
XP1 n_nor b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XP2 n_nor a z vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current mirror.
* Two segmented NMOS mirror banks (ICC-fed and IPTAT-fed). Each bank has
* 4 diode-connected input units sharing the 50 uA reference (12.5 uA each,
* W=6) and 16 cascode output units (W=24, same current density) each
* mirroring 50 uA. Output units are enabled/disabled in groups of 4 by
* switching their bottom-device GATE between the reference gate node and
* vss: a PMOS pass gate (gate = ~en, bulk tied to its source so body effect
* never raises its threshold) plus an NMOS pulldown (gate = ~en), driven by
* static CMOS decode logic. Code changes draw no static digital current and
* do not disturb the reference pins.
* Cascode bias ncas is a high-density NMOS diode (~5x the output current
* density) fed by a PMOS current source referenced to an R-degenerated
* PMOS diode branch, giving ncas ~= Vth + 2.2*Vov (wide-swing bias that
* tracks process/temperature/mobility), keeping both stacked devices
* saturated down to ~0.45 V at the iout pin while output resistance is
* boosted ~gm/gds over a plain mirror.
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---------------- decode logic (static CMOS, flat) ----------------
* inverses of the two bits: nb0 = ~b0, nb1 = ~b1

XPINV0 nb0 ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XNINV1 nb1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XPINV1 nb1 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
* nand10 = ~(b1 & b0)  (ICC group k4-7 enable)
XNND1 nand_n1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XNND2 nand10 ratio_b0 nand_n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XPND1 nand10 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XPND2 nand10 ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
* nor10 = ~(b1 | b0)   (ICC group k12-15 enable)
XPNR1 nor_n1 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XPNR2 nor10 ratio_b0 nor_n1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
