taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable NMOS current-sink mirror combining an ICC reference and an
* IPTAT reference.
*
* Architecture:
*  - Each reference pin drives a diode-connected NMOS input (one per ref),
*    forming gate lines at one Vgs.  Pin voltage is one Vgs (~0.5-0.8 V over
*    the three signoff corners), inside the 0.20-1.10 V compliance window.
*  - 20 cascode output units of 50 uA each sum into iout (1.00 mA nominal).
*    Each unit's bottom gate is switched between the two reference gate lines
*    by two NMOS pass gates driven by the 2-bit code and its complement
*    (two CMOS inverters).  Segmentation gives:
*      code 00: 16 ICC /  4 IPTAT ; code 01: 12 ICC /  8 IPTAT
*      code 10:  8 ICC / 12 IPTAT ; code 11:  4 ICC / 16 IPTAT
*  - The cascode gate bias vcas is fed from vdd through a resistor (~15 uA)
*    into a wide-swing stack: a diode NMOS (M3) stacked on an NMOS (M2) whose
*    gate is the ICC mirror line.  This settles at vcas ~= Vth + ~0.25 V,
*    tracking process and temperature and keeping every output bottom device
*    saturated; the resistor feed isolates vcas from reference perturbations.
*  - Mirror and cascode devices use l=3 to suppress channel-length modulation
*    (ratio error and output resistance); the output compliance floor is
*    ~0.4 V across corners.
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ================================================================ reference
* diode inputs, matched to the output bottom devices (50 uA each); long L
* suppresses channel-length-modulation ratio error
XGID   icc_ref   icc_ref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=192 nf=8
XGPD   iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=192 nf=8
* large pulldowns give the gate lines a dc path for the operating-point
* solver (~8 nA, negligible against the 50 uA reference)
RPD1 icc_ref   vss 100meg
RPD2 iptat_ref vss 100meg

* ================================================================ bit decode
XINV0 ratio_b0 nb0 vdd vss inv_cmos
XINV1 ratio_b1 nb1 vdd vss inv_cmos

* ================================================================ output units
* 4 fixed ICC (sel=vdd), 4 fixed IPTAT (sel=vss), 4 switched by b0, 8 by b1.
XO01 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref vdd      vss      outunit
XO02 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref vdd      vss      outunit
XO03 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref vdd      vss      outunit
XO04 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref vdd      vss      outunit
XO05 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref vss      vdd      outunit
XO06 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref vss      vdd      outunit
XO07 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref vss      vdd      outunit
XO08 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref vss      vdd      outunit
* switched groups select ICC when the bit is 0 (ACC = 16 - 4*b0 - 8*b1)
XO09 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref nb0      ratio_b0 outunit
XO10 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref nb0      ratio_b0 outunit
XO11 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref nb0      ratio_b0 outunit
XO12 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref nb0      ratio_b0 outunit
XO13 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref nb1      ratio_b1 outunit
XO14 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref nb1      ratio_b1 outunit
XO15 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref nb1      ratio_b1 outunit
XO16 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref nb1      ratio_b1 outunit
XO17 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref nb1      ratio_b1 outunit
XO18 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref nb1      ratio_b1 outunit
XO19 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref nb1      ratio_b1 outunit
XO20 iout vcas vss icc_ref iptat_ref nb1      ratio_b1 outunit

* ================================================================ bias
* vcas feeds from vdd through Rfeed (~15 uA) into a wide-swing stack:
* M3 diode over M2 (gate = ICC line; M2 is trioded and drops only tens of
* mV).  vcas settles near Vth + ~0.25 V, so each output bottom device
* (vov ~0.1 V) is held saturated while the cascode (vov ~0.12 V) preserves
* high output resistance down to an iout floor near 0.4 V.  The resistor
* feed keeps vcas off the reference gate lines, so a +/-5 uA reference
* perturbation does not move the other pin.
RFED vdd  vcas 50k
XM3  vcas vcas n1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=1.2 nf=1
XM2  n1   icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3   w=192 nf=8

.ends programmable_current_mirror

* ------------------------------------------------------------------ outunit
* One 50 uA cascode sink.  Bottom gate gnet is switched to gicc (sel high) or
* gipt (nsel high) by minimum-length NMOS pass gates; gate nodes draw no dc.
.subckt outunit iout vcas vss gicc gipt sel nsel
XQ   gnet sel  gicc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XQB  gnet nsel gipt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XA   xmid gnet vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3    w=192 nf=8
XB   iout vcas xmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3    w=168 nf=8
.ends outunit

* ------------------------------------------------------------------ inverter
.subckt inv_cmos in out vdd vss
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
.ends inv_cmos

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current-sink mirror (wide-swing cascode).
*
* Architecture
* ------------
* Each reference pin is a direct diode-connected LVT NMOS (pin voltage is
* one Vgs, ~0.4-0.75 V across corners, inside the 0.20-1.10 V window).  The
* two gate buses (the pins themselves) are never connected to each other, so
* the reference pins are isolated.
*
* Eight wide-swing cascode mirror segments sink into iout.  Each enabled
* segment copies 4x its reference (200 uA from 50 uA).  Four segments copy
* ICC, four copy IPTAT; the 2-bit code steers each segment's inner-FET gate
* between its gate bus (transmission gate) and vss (clamp NMOS):
*
*   code 00: ICC segs on = 4, PTAT = 1 -> ACC=16, APTAT=4
*   code 01: ICC segs on = 3, PTAT = 2 -> ACC=12, APTAT=8
*   code 10: ICC segs on = 2, PTAT = 3 -> ACC=8,  APTAT=12
*   code 11: ICC segs on = 1, PTAT = 4 -> ACC=4,  APTAT=16
*
* Mirror segments run at ~1 uA/um (overdrive ~0.12 V), so the cascode stack
* stays saturated with iout as low as 0.45 V and the cascoded output
* resistance is in the Mohm range (spec: 100 kohm).
*
* The cascode gate bias vcasc is a wide-swing generator: leg A is a PMOS
* diode feeding an NMOS that mirrors the ICC reference bus (1/4 unit), so
* its ~12.5 uA bias current tracks the references over process and
* temperature; a 1:1 PMOS mirror feeds that current into a high-density
* grounded-source NMOS diode (leg B) whose Vgs is Vref + ~3*Vov, keeping
* both the inner mirror FETs and the cascodes saturated across corners
* (the extra margin covers cascode body effect).  Static vdd current is
* ~25 uA.  Decode is static CMOS (zero static digital current).
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- decode ---
XIB0 ratio_b0 b0n vdd vss inv_lvt
XIB1 ratio_b1 b1n vdd vss inv_lvt
XN6  ratio_b1 ratio_b0 n6  vdd vss nand2_lvt
XN5  ratio_b1 ratio_b0 n5  vdd vss nor2_lvt
XN7  b1n b0n n7  vdd vss nand2_lvt
XIN6 n6 n6b vdd vss inv_lvt
XIN5 n5 n5b vdd vss inv_lvt
XIN7 n7 n7b vdd vss inv_lvt

* ------------------------------------------- cascode gate bias generator ---
* Leg A: PMOS diode feeding an NMOS that mirrors the ICC reference bus
* (W=15 at L=8 -> ~12.5 uA, i.e. 1/4 of a 50 uA reference unit).
XMPA pbias pbias vdd  vdd     sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=4  nf=2
XMNA pbias icc_ref vss vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8.0 w=15 nf=5
* Leg B: PMOS mirror into a high-density NMOS diode (W=1 at ~12.5 uA is
* ~15x segment density -> vcasc = Vref + ~3*Vov, tracking over corners).
XMPB vcasc pbias vdd  vdd     sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=4  nf=2
XMNB vcasc vcasc vss  vss     sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8.0 w=1  nf=1

* -------------------------------------------------------- reference diodes -
* 50 uA through W=60/L=8 matches the 200 uA / W=240 inner-FET density.
XNIC icc_ref icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8.0 w=60 nf=10
XNIP iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8.0 w=60 nf=10

* ------------------------------------------- ICC cascode segments (4) ------
* Seg I1: always on, inner gate hard tied to icc_ref.
XI1A i1x icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8.0 w=240 nf=20
XI1B iout vcasc  i1x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=200 nf=20
* Seg I2: enable n6 (high except code 11)
XI2A i2x gi2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8.0 w=240 nf=20
XI2B iout vcasc i2x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=200 nf=20
XTI2N gi2 n6  icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
XTI2P gi2 n6b icc_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
XKI2  gi2 n6b vss     vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
* Seg I3: enable b1n (codes with b1=0)
XI3A i3x gi3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8.0 w=240 nf=20
XI3B iout vcasc i3x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=200 nf=20
XTI3N gi3 b1n icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
XTI3P gi3 ratio_b1 icc_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
XKI3  gi3 ratio_b1 vss     vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
* Seg I4: enable n5 (code 00 only)
XI4A i4x gi4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8.0 w=240 nf=20
XI4B iout vcasc i4x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=200 nf=20
XTI4N gi4 n5  icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
XTI4P gi4 n5b icc_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
XKI4  gi4 n5b vss     vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2

* ------------------------------------------ PTAT cascode segments (4) ------
* Seg P1: always on, inner gate hard tied to iptat_ref.
XP1A p1x iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8.0 w=240 nf=20
XP1B iout vcasc p1x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=200 nf=20
* Seg P2: enable n7 (b1 OR b0)
XP2A p2x gp2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8.0 w=240 nf=20
XP2B iout vcasc p2x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=200 nf=20
XTP2N gp2 n7  iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
XTP2P gp2 n7b iptat_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
XKP2  gp2 n7b vss        vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
* Seg P3: enable b1
XP3A p3x gp3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8.0 w=240 nf=20
XP3B iout vcasc p3x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=200 nf=20
XTP3N gp3 ratio_b1 iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
XTP3P gp3 b1n      iptat_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
XKP3  gp3 b1n      vss        vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
* Seg P4: enable n6b (b1 AND b0)
XP4A p4x gp4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8.0 w=240 nf=20
XP4B iout vcasc p4x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=200 nf=20
XTP4N gp4 n6b iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
XTP4P gp4 n6  iptat_ref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
XKP4  gp4 n6  vss        vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2

.ends programmable_current_mirror

* ------------------------------------------------------------- logic cells -
.subckt inv_lvt in out vdd vss
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
.ends inv_lvt

.subckt nand2_lvt a b out vdd vss
XP1 out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
XP2 out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
XN1 out a xn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XN2 xn  b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
.ends nand2_lvt

.subckt nor2_lvt a b out vdd vss
XP1 out a xp  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
XP2 xp  b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2 nf=2
XN1 out a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XN2 out b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
.ends nor2_lvt

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable NMOS ICC/IPTAT current mirror -- Sky130 1.8V core devices.
*
* Concept
* -------
*   icc_ref / iptat_ref are diode-connected NMOS reference legs carrying the
*   forced reference currents; their drain/gate voltage is the mirror gate
*   bias for the corresponding group.
*   Each programmed branch is an NMOS mirror device whose gate is selected
*   between the group reference voltage and vss by an NMOS pass device plus
*   an NMOS pull-down driven by the complementary logic level.  No current
*   flows through either select device in steady state, so the reference
*   pins see no loading, no static digital current is drawn, and the only
*   vdd current is the two logic-inverter pull-up resistors.
*   All branch drains tie directly to the iout sink node.
*
*   code 00 : ACC=16 APTAT= 4      code 10 : ACC= 8 APTAT=12
*   code 01 : ACC=12 APTAT= 8      code 11 : ACC= 4 APTAT=16
*
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Reference legs: diode-connected unit devices (W/L = 50 at 50 uA).
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XDICC   icc_ref   icc_ref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=1000 nf=2
XDIPT   iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=1000 nf=2

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Local logic inversions: nb0 = /b0, nb1 = /b1  (resistive NMOS inverters)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XNBB0   nb0 b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=400 nf=2
RPU0    vdd nb0 2meg
XNBB1   nb1 b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=400 nf=2
RPU1    vdd nb1 2meg

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* ICC group:  ACC = 8*(1-b1) + 4*(1-b0) + 4
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* 8x branch, enabled when b1 = 0
XSWC8   swc8 nb1 icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=1000 nf=2
XPDC8   swc8 b1  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=500 nf=2
XMC8    iout swc8 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=8000 nf=16
* 4x branch, enabled when b0 = 0
XSWC4   swc4 nb0 icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=1000 nf=2
XPDC4   swc4 b0  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=500 nf=2
XMC4    iout swc4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=4000 nf=8
* 4x branch, always selected
XMC4A   iout icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=4000 nf=8

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* IPTAT group:  APTAT = 4 + 4*b0 + 8*b1
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* 4x branch, enabled when b0 = 1
XSWP4   swp4 b0  iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=1000 nf=2
XPDP4   swp4 nb0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=500 nf=2
XMP4    iout swp4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=4000 nf=8
* 8x branch, enabled when b1 = 1
XSWP8   swp8 b1  iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=1000 nf=2
XPDP8   swp8 nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=500 nf=2
XMP8    iout swp8 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=8000 nf=16
* 4x branch, always selected
XMP4A   iout iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=4000 nf=8

.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable NMOS current-sink mirror: ICC + IPTAT references, 2-bit ratio.
*
* One mirror "unit cell" is l=8um w=320um (10um fingers), which carries 50uA at
* 27C.  The long channel is deliberate: the mirror cells sit at Vds = V(xs)
* (~0.17V) while the input diode sits at Vds = Vgs (~0.63V), and that Vds
* mismatch is the dominant mirror error.  Doubling L and W together halves the
* channel-length-modulation error while leaving every node voltage (and so the
* compliance headroom) unchanged.
*
* Twenty unit cells form the output sink and are shared between the ICC rail
* and the IPTAT rail by the 2-bit code; the reference pins ARE the mirror rails
* (each pin is one diode-connected unit cell), so each pin sits at its own Vgs
* (~0.62V), no current can flow from one pin to the other, and the pin voltage
* cannot depend on the code (the muxed cells load the rail with gate
* capacitance only -- the select pass devices carry no DC current).
*
*   group A  4 units  hard-wired to icc_ref
*   group B  8 units  icc_ref when b1=0, iptat_ref when b1=1
*   group C  4 units  icc_ref when b0=0, iptat_ref when b0=1
*   group D  4 units  hard-wired to iptat_ref
*
*   code 00 -> 16 ICC / 4 IPTAT    code 01 -> 12 / 8
*   code 10 ->  8 ICC /12 IPTAT    code 11 ->  4 /16
*
* The output stage is a wide-swing (Sooch) cascode.  Its bias branch is fed
* from vdd through a resistor, so the cascode gate voltage is completely
* independent of both reference pins: perturbing ICC or IPTAT cannot move the
* internal source node of the mirror cells, which keeps the measured ACC and
* APTAT weights free of cross-coupling.
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ---- reference input diodes: one unit cell per rail, rail = pin ----
XDI icc_ref icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=320 nf=32
XDP iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=320 nf=32

* ---- output bottom mirror devices: 20 unit cells (320um each) onto node xs,
*      split into <=1010um instances for the binned short-channel model ----
XGA1 xs icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=640 nf=64
XGA2 xs icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=640 nf=64
XGB1 xs gsel_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=640 nf=64
XGB2 xs gsel_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=640 nf=64
XGB3 xs gsel_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=640 nf=64
XGB4 xs gsel_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=640 nf=64
XGC1 xs gsel_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=640 nf=64
XGC2 xs gsel_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=640 nf=64
XGD1 xs iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=640 nf=64
XGD2 xs iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=640 nf=64

* ---- output cascode: 3x the unit-cell width at l=2 so its Vdsat stays small ----
XCA1 iout vb xs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XCA2 iout vb xs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XCA3 iout vb xs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XCA4 iout vb xs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XCA5 iout vb xs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XCA6 iout vb xs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XCA7 iout vb xs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XCA8 iout vb xs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XCA9 iout vb xs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XCA10 iout vb xs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XCA11 iout vb xs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80
XCA12 iout vb xs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=80

* ---- rail-select pass devices for the muxed groups (no DC gate current) ----
XPB1 gsel_b1 n1 icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.5 nf=1
XPB2 gsel_b1 ratio_b1 iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.5 nf=1
XPC1 gsel_b0 n0 icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.5 nf=1
XPC2 gsel_b0 ratio_b0 iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.5 nf=1

* ---- code inverters (static CMOS: zero vdd current, zero pin current) ----
XIP0 n0 ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.5 nf=1
XIN0 n0 ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.5 nf=1
XIP1 n1 ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.5 nf=1
XIN1 n1 ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.5 nf=1

* ---- wide-swing cascode bias ----
* RB feeds the branch from vdd; XS1 runs at the unit-cell current density so
* its overdrive tracks the mirror cells' across temperature, and XS2 (gate =
* vb) is forced into triode and makes node xsb stiff.  Result:
*   vb    = Vth + Vov(XS1)*sqrt(1+alpha)
*   V(xs) = Vov(XS1)*sqrt(1+alpha) - Vov(cascode)
* with alpha = (W1/L1)/(W2/L2).  V(xs) holds no Vth term, so it tracks the
* mirror cells' Vdsat across corners, and because XS2 keeps l=8 while staying
* narrow, alpha is large enough to place V(xs) well above Vdsat yet far below
* the compliance ceiling.
RB vdd vb 47k
XS1 vb vb xsb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=128 nf=8
XS2 xsb vb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=7.5 nf=1

.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout

* ================================================================
* Input diodes - create gate voltages for current mirrors
* W/L=32, L=2um, W=64um, nf=10 (w/nf=6.4um)
* ================================================================
X_icc_in icc_ref icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=64 nf=10
X_iptat_in iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=64 nf=10

* ================================================================
* Cascode bias generator
* PMOS current mirror copies ICC current through two stacked
* NMOS diodes. cascode_bias = 2*Vgs_ref ≈ 1.31V.
* Mirror drain settles at ~Vgs_ref, ensuring saturation.
* ================================================================

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable NMOS current-sink mirror: ICC + IPTAT, 2-bit ratio control
* Iout = ACC*ICC + APTAT*IPTAT ; ACC+APTAT = 20 -> 1 mA at 27 C for all codes
* Topology:
*   - Diode-connected reference NMOS per pin (1:1 mirror gate drive).
*   - Parallel unit sinks (4 sinks/unit via m=4), gated by decoded ratio code.
*   - All unit drains tie to cascode source node X; one cascode device (gate Vb)
*     lifts output resistance without consuming the 0.45 V compliance headroom.
*   - Vb self-biased (diode NMOS Mb + resistor to vdd) so X tracks across corners.
* Only Sky130 MOS subcircuits + ideal resistors inside the DUT.
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Reference front ends: each pin sits on its own diode-connected NMOS *
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
XREF_ICC  icc_ref icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=1000 nf=1
XREF_IPT  iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=1000 nf=1

*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Cascode bias: self-biased gate voltage Vb                          *
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
RBb vdd Vb 30k
XMb Vb Vb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=24 nf=1

*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Static-CMOS ratio decode (zero static current, rail-to-rail 0/vdd) *
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* b0n = !b0
XPi0 b0n ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNi0 b0n ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* b1n = !b1
XPi1 b1n ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNi1 b1n ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* nand_bb = !(b1 && b0)  -> ICC unit-2 enable
XPn1 nand_bb ratio_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XPn2 nand_bb ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNn1 nand_bb ratio_b1 nn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNn2 nn1 ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XPo1 or_bb ratio_b1 no1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XPo2 no1 ratio_b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNo1 or_bb ratio_b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNo2 or_bb ratio_b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XPa1 and_bb nand_bb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNa1 and_bb nand_bb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XPo3 nor_bb or_bb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNo3 nor_bb or_bb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* ICC units : unit-j sinks 4*ICC ; enables per code table            *
*   u1 always on (gate tied to icc_ref)      u4 EN=or_bb  (00 only)   *
*   u2 EN=nand_bb  (00,01,10)   u3 EN=b1n (00,01)                    *
*   All drains tie to cascode node X.                                *
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
XIS11 x icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=1000 nf=1 m=4
XPS2 icc_ref nand_bb gic2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
RR2 gic2 vss 100meg
XIS21 x gic2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=1000 nf=1 m=4
XPS3 icc_ref b1n gic3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
RR3 gic3 vss 100meg
XIS31 x gic3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=1000 nf=1 m=4
XPS4 icc_ref or_bb gic4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
RR4 gic4 vss 100meg
XIS41 x gic4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=1000 nf=1 m=4

*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* IPTAT units : unit-j sinks 4*IPTAT                                 *
*   u1 always on         u2 EN=nor_bb (01,10,11)  u4 EN=and_bb (11)  *
*   u3 EN=b1 (10,11)                                             *
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
XIP11 x iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=1000 nf=1 m=4
XPS5 iptat_ref nor_bb gip2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
RR5 gip2 vss 100meg
XIP21 x gip2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=1000 nf=1 m=4
XPS6 iptat_ref ratio_b1 gip3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
RR6 gip3 vss 100meg
XIP31 x gip3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=1000 nf=1 m=4
XPS7 iptat_ref and_bb gip4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
RR7 gip4 vss 100meg
XIP41 x gip4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=1000 nf=1 m=4

*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Cascode output device: boosts output resistance                    *
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
XM2 iout Vb x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=1000 nf=1 m=8
.ends programmable_current_mirror

taskTitle: Design a Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS Current Mirror
circuit:
* Programmable ICC/IPTAT NMOS current mirror
* Iout = ACC*ICC + APTAT*IPTAT, ACC + APTAT = 20  (20 x 50 uA = 1 mA at 27 C)
* code c = 2*b1 + b0:  ICC units = 4-c,  IPTAT units = c+1,  one unit = 200 uA
* (each unit = 2 x 100-uA devices = 4x the 50-uA reference device).
*
* Digital enables (thermometer decoded from b1:b0):
*   ICC : u3 always on, u2=nand_c, u1=!b1, u0=nor_c   -> 4-c units on
*   IPTAT: v0 always on, v1=or_c,   v2=b1,    v3=and_c -> c+1 units on
* Complementary switches connect each unit gate to its reference pin (ON)
* or to vss (OFF); 1-Meg bleeds keep every internal gate node at a defined
* DC potential with zero static current.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt programmable_current_mirror vss vdd icc_ref iptat_ref ratio_b0 ratio_b1 iout
*---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Reference legs: diode-connected nfet returns the forced reference
* current to vss, so icc_ref/iptat_ref sit at VGS(50 uA).  Mirror gates
* copying this VGS reproduce current in device-width ratio, tracking
* process and temperature.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------
XRICC icc_ref icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=400 nf=1
XRIPTAT iptat_ref iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=400 nf=1
RICCR icc_ref vss 1meg
RIPTR iptat_ref vss 1meg

*---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Digital decode: CMOS from vdd/vss, zero static current
* n0 = !b0   nb1 = !b1
*---------------------------------------------------------------------
XI0N n0 b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XI0P n0 b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XNB1N nb1 b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNB1P nb1 b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

*---------------------------------------------------------------------
* NAND(b1,b0)=nand_c ; NOR(b1,b0)=nor_c ; and_c=!nand_c ; or_c=!nor_c
*---------------------------------------------------------------------
XNA nand_c b1 nx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XNB nx b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XPA nand_c b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XPB nand_c b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
RNX nx vss 1meg
XNA1 nor_c b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XNA2 nor_c b0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XPA1 nor_c b1 ny vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XPA2 ny b0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
RNY ny vss 1meg
XIAN and_c nand_c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XIAP and_c nand_c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XIOR or_c nor_c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XIOP or_c nor_c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
RB0 ratio_b0 vss 10meg
RB1 ratio_b1 vss 10meg

*---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Complementary branch switches per unit.
*   Switch A: gate=enable,  source=ref pin  -> gau node = ref pin  (unit ON)
*   Switch B: gate=!enable, source=vss      -> gau node = vss      (unit OFF)
* 1-Meg bleed on every gau node => defined DC level, no floating node,
* no static current (both switch terminals sit at the same potential when on).
*---------------------------------------------------------------------
* ICC enables: u3 always on; u2=nand_c; u1=nb1; u0=nor_c  (4-c units on)
XSWIC2A gau_ic2 nand_c icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XSWIC2B gau_ic2 and_c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
RGIC2 gau_ic2 vss 1e7
XSWIC1A gau_ic1 nb1 icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XSWIC1B gau_ic1 b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
RGIC1 gau_ic1 vss 1e7
XSWIC0A gau_ic0 nor_c icc_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XSWIC0B gau_ic0 or_c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
RGIC0 gau_ic0 vss 1e7
* IPTAT enables: v0 always on; v1=or_c; v2=b1; v3=and_c  (c+1 units on)
XSWIP1A gau_ip1 or_c iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XSWIP1B gau_ip1 nor_c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
RGIP1 gau_ip1 vss 1e7
XSWIP2A gau_ip2 b1 iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XSWIP2B gau_ip2 nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
RGIP2 gau_ip2 vss 1e7
XSWIP3A gau_ip3 and_c iptat_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XSWIP3B gau_ip3 nand_c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
RGIP3 gau_ip3 vss 1e7

*---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Mirror devices: each unit = 2 x (l=8 w=800 nf=2) = 4x the 50-uA ref.
* u3/v0 gates tied directly to the ref pins; switched units via gau nodes.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMICC31 iout icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=800 nf=2
XMICC32 iout icc_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=800 nf=2
XMICC21 iout gau_ic2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=800 nf=2
XMICC22 iout gau_ic2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=800 nf=2
XMICC11 iout gau_ic1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=800 nf=2
XMICC12 iout gau_ic1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=800 nf=2
XMICC01 iout gau_ic0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=800 nf=2
XMICC02 iout gau_ic0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=800 nf=2
XMIPT01 iout iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=800 nf=2
XMIPT02 iout iptat_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=800 nf=2
XMIPT11 iout gau_ip1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=800 nf=2
XMIPT12 iout gau_ip1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=800 nf=2
XMIPT21 iout gau_ip2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=800 nf=2
XMIPT22 iout gau_ip2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=800 nf=2
XMIPT31 iout gau_ip3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=800 nf=2
XMIPT32 iout gau_ip3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=800 nf=2
.ends programmable_current_mirror
